725.right:
Composition

Some people want that when a specific person speaks about a certain topic in a meeting, especially in front of those who do not understand its meaning and purpose or misinterpret it, and in which a specific purpose or a specific type of meeting has been decided, then they come to this meeting very quickly and quickly want to impose their views on others, but they do not know that the meeting organizers already know how such people will behave, so they try to deal with such people in a specific way and pay attention to the main purpose of the meeting instead of their words. Therefore, they conduct the meeting's affairs according to a specific procedure and try to use a special measure to maintain the order of the meeting so that no problem arises during the meeting and in the end, the meeting concludes peacefully and no disagreement arises among the people, and everyone is given the opportunity to express their views peacefully and show harmony with the meeting's decisions.
725.left: In the month of Rabi' al-Thani of the year 1291, a large meeting was held in the city of Kabul, in which a number of other people, including many prominent figures and scholars of the country, participated. In this meeting, discussions were held on many topics related to the current situation of the country, the development of education, and the welfare of the people. One of the important points of this meeting was the creation of a new policy for the development of education, based on which new schools should have been built in various regions of the country and special steps should have been taken to spread knowledge and understanding among the people. The participants of the meeting emphasized that education is the most essential thing for the country's progress and every Afghan should fulfill their responsibility in this regard. In the meeting, proposals were also made by a number of people for printing books and publishing magazines, which were accepted by the leaders of the meeting. The meeting concluded with all participants agreeing that taking the path of education and unity is essential for a strong future.

Gentlemen!

This is a repetition of a part that was previously published in past issues. Although it is not about this month's topic, it is important for unity among Afghans. It should be considered by all. This is essentially a summary of a Jirga by Khan Sahib that was held to strengthen unity and brotherhood among the people. Khan Sahib, in his speech, expressed regret over conflicts and disagreements among the people, stating that this is the biggest obstacle to our progress. He encouraged people to resolve their differences through Jirga and choose love and brotherhood instead of enmity among themselves. According to him, if we unite, no power can stop us. At the end of this Jirga, many people pledged to abandon their internal differences from now on and work for a common goal. This was an important step taken for positive change in the society of that time. Khan Sahib's speech had a profound impact on the hearts of the people, and many pledged to implement it. The demand of this Jirga was that all Afghans should consider their national interests higher than personal interests and work together for the development of the country.
729.left: Regarding this, I must say that Khan Sahib's speech was at a time when the country's situation was very critical. People were grappling with various problems, and the need for unity was greatly felt. Khan Sahib, in his speech, greatly emphasized the importance of unity and said that the secret of our success lies only in unity. He added that to thwart the enemies' conspiracies, we must stand as one. The jirga participants, upon hearing Khan Sahib's speeches, felt joy and unanimously supported his proposals. Regarding the results of this jirga, we will publish more information in the next issue. We hope that by reading this article, our esteemed readers will understand the value of their unity and fulfill their responsibility in this path. Every individual of the country is responsible for this national mission to raise their voice for unity and stop those who sow discord. In this text, a deep analysis of the British atrocities and the aspirations for freedom of the people of India has been presented. This text is a clear example of the stance of the newspapers of that time regarding the Indian independence movement, which played an important role in awakening the people for the end of colonialism. The writers of this newspaper had bravely raised their voice against the atrocities of the British government.

The Accountability and Recompense of the Hereafter

This great truth of my life is that in my life there are these two things, and every day they are in conflict with each other, and over this, my intellect and wisdom are in conflict with the enemy, Satan. One is that my intellect and wisdom tell me to step onto God's path in this life and accept God's command in the world instead of its (the world's) sovereignty, and the other is that Satan casts temptations of such deeds upon me at every moment that are the means of destroying my religion and faith.

Satan tries to diminish my faith through my own authority and my own worshipped things, from the friends of Allah and from all kinds of dangers in His path. Satan is very skilled in this; he always takes advantage of the weakness of the human heart. He enters the human heart every moment and sows the seed of doubt and suspicion in every matter. Although it is God's promise that Satan always fails in such paths, due to human weakness and frailty, one sometimes gets entangled in these sins and, by departing from His guidance, follows Satan.
804.left:
In this path, humanity's greatest enemy is with their own carnal desires and the whispers of Satan. In order that man may find salvation from Satan's whispers, he must keep himself busy in the remembrance of God, by implementing the guidance of the Holy Quran, and by associating with such people who serve the religion of Allah, strengthen his faith.

This war with Satan is not for one day or one hour, but it is a continuous struggle for an entire lifetime. Man must understand that Satan, until the end of his life, tries to divert him from his path, therefore, it is necessary for every Muslim to make supplications in the court of his Lord for the protection of his soul and to seek refuge in God from the evil of Satan.

For enmity with Satan, the unity of Muslims and remaining steadfast on the path of religion is an essential condition. When a Muslim gets caught in Satan's whispers, then he must immediately return to the presence of God through repentance and take steps to correct his mistake, because God is with those who repent and He has guided His servants for salvation from the evil of Satan.

Whoever does not believe in God's law for the betterment of life's affairs, in fact, commits a great betrayal against himself and his nation. If the pages of history are turned, it will become clear that many nations of the world have adopted the path of rebellion and revolution against the oppressions and unjust actions of their masters. The sacrifices they have made on this path are written in golden letters on the pages of history. But we should not forget that behind every successful revolution there is the hand of such a group that has come to the field risking their lives to obtain their rights and does not care about any kind of problems or difficulties. Any nation that is united for the protection of its rights can never face humiliation and misery.

Without knowledge, the progress and development of nations is impossible. By the grace of God and the unity of the nation, we can build a bright future for our coming generations. In the end, we must say that remaining loyal to our country is a great moral responsibility for each of us.

812.right:
Introduction
Adabi Press is an Islamic center for organizing the unity of Muslims and gaining freedom. It is used for spreading Islam, uniting Muslims, and freeing them from all kinds of oppression. For those who believe in this, there is no better opportunity than this to strive for the propagation of religion. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said in a Hadith: "Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or oppressed," meaning, help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or oppressed. In this Hadith, oppression means that the hand of the oppressor should be stopped and his oppression prevented, and the oppressed means that he should be supported and his rights given to him. In Islam, oppression is considered the worst of all deeds, and it is obligatory for Muslims to rise up against oppression.
The pure religion of Islam is a religion of justice and fairness. In it, all Muslims are equal without any kind of distinction or discrimination. For the purpose that Muslims understand each other's difficulties and work for their solution, the efforts of Adabi Press cannot be denied. The news published in it is for the awakening of Muslims and the defense of their rights.
812.left:
Furthermore, in Kabul these days, a large gathering has been called for, whose purpose is to organize the unity and solidarity of Muslims. For this gathering, people are gathering from all directions, and they offer their advice for the progress of Islam and the unity of Muslims. This is a matter of joy for every Muslim that such an endeavor is taking place under the patronage of an Islamic government. There is no doubt that such gatherings play a very significant role in the awakening of Muslims.
Everyone who believes in this purpose does not spare their efforts for it. This is an opportunity for Muslims to gather in one place and pave the way for the solution of their problems. For the success of this gathering, the support of all Muslims is necessary, and it is the duty of every individual to play their role in this endeavor.

Identification

For the identification of the enemies of the homeland, this is a long tradition and ancient method, that every nation has found a way to identify the enemy in the pages of its history for the identification of the enemies of the homeland and nation. If a nation wants not to fail in identifying the enemies of its homeland and nation, then it should read the following lines carefully. These lines have been written with great bravery and honor, so that every member of our nation should understand them and act upon them. This identification of the enemy is extremely essential for the survival and progress of our nation, because the enemies of the nation often enter among the people in the guise of friends and fulfill their impure objectives. In these lines, there are very important guidelines for identifying enemies, which determine the path of action for every individual of the nation. For the identification of the enemies of our nation for their actions, the names of the following individuals have been mentioned:
(1) Fazal Ahmad Sahib (2) Nasrullah Sahib (3) Maulana Ubaidullah Sahib (4) Haji Sahib. In addition to these, the names of other individuals have also been mentioned, regarding whom it is also necessary for others to pay full attention to each other for the identification of the homeland, so that damage to the homeland can be prevented.

In this path, the role of every citizen, especially the owners of the pen and writers, is very significant in awakening the consciousness of the people of the country and informing them about the dangers from the enemies.

822.right:
August 1920

Regarding the publication of articles

We write a few words for our readers in the name of the officials of Pashtun weekly magazine regarding the publication of articles of Pashtun weekly magazine. The purpose of publishing our magazine and printing writings is to create a culture of reading and a spirit of understanding scientific and social issues among the Pashtun nation. The door of our publication is open for every Pashtun brother who wishes well for his nation and people and strives through the pen for the advancement of Pashto literature and Pashtunkhwa. We request all those respected individuals to write their articles in standard Pashto language and avoid unnecessary and inappropriate remarks. As the editor of the magazine, our duty is to thoroughly consider the content of the writings and not publish anything that is against religion or the unity of the nation. We respect the opinions of our readers and welcome every such writing that benefits the Pashtun nation. For the further improvement of the publication, we call upon all our Pashtun brothers to participate in this national media and send us their scientific, literary, and historical writings so that work can be done for the enrichment of the Pashto language and the awakening of the Pashtun nation. This magazine is yours and with your support, it will achieve its goals.

First of all, Pashtun, like a weekly magazine, in the path of publishing a new and advanced magazine, with the aim of protecting the interests of all the Pashtun people, has made this effort from the very first day to start a scientific and reformative movement among the people through the pen for the service of its language and culture. Although as a new publication, we face some challenges, but by the grace of God and with the support of the people, we hope that as a powerful magazine, it will be an effective step for the Pashtun nation's demand for rights and progress. In this regard, we appeal to all Pashtun writers and lovers of the Pashto language to help strengthen this magazine by publishing their writings and to work as a common goal for the development of the Pashto language. This magazine is a voice for awakening the consciousness of the Pashtun nation and a shield for defending the rights of every Pashtun brother and sister. With every writing that reaches us, we give it full consideration and try to publish it for the general public to read for a sacred purpose. Finally, we thank all those who have raised their voice in support of our national magazine.

859.right: In the past year (1920), a publication named "Afghan," which was an important element of the national liberation movement, was published among the intellectuals of the country for the awakening of the people and the understanding of their rights. Among the objectives of this publication, it was clear that the nation should participate in determining its own destiny and unite against the conspiracies of colonialism. As stated in the text, raising the level of public unity and political awareness is essential for the improvement of the country's situation, because illiteracy and foreign servitude lead to the decline of a nation. We must learn lessons from the past history of our ancestors and lay a strong foundation for the future, so that future generations may live a life of dignity. The path of knowledge and enlightenment is the only way to progress through which we can save our country from this crisis. The slogan of unity and brotherhood should be in the heart of every Afghan, because division fulfills the goals of enemies and our country becomes prey to others. So it is necessary to work together for national interests and, under the guidance of our leaders, take part in building a free and independent Afghanistan.

On the eighth (8) of July, a meeting of the Pashto Academy was held, in which, according to the decision of Mr. Khan Sahib, an agreement was reached on the compilation of a magnificent book in the Pashto language and the preparation of its draft. To accomplish this task, with the vote of Mr. Khan Sahib, a committee of four renowned Pashto language writers was formed, and it was decided that the work of writing this book would be carried out with the consultation of the members of this committee. This committee will hold meetings repeatedly and will assist in preparing the draft of this book with full accuracy. In the list of names of the members of this committee, the name of Ghulam Mohammad Khan Sahib was also enthusiastically proposed by Khan Sahib, and during this meeting, with great respect for Ghulam Mohammad Khan Sahib and with the consensus of the people, it was decided that this book would be written under the care and supervision of Ghulam Mohammad Khan Sahib and would hold a high position in the Pashto language. At the end of the meeting, Khan Sahib praised the courage and efforts of all members for the success of this important work and prayed that Allah Almighty would complete this work in the best possible way.

The Good Day of the Oppressed

(From Mr. Maulana Karimli Sahib Noshehrawi)

The Day of the Oppressed, according to this blessed Hadith (Beware of the prayer of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah), is the day when the oppressor is punished for his oppression. On this day, the oppressor must understand that his power, excess, and injustice will not go unanswered before Allah Almighty. This day is for accounting for the injustices of those oppressors who have trampled upon people's rights and have not handed over their rights to the rightful owners. On this day, the oppressed is given the opportunity to express his heartfelt condition and raise his voice against the oppressor's injustices. In Islam, great importance is given to the rights of the oppressed, and in the light of Islamic Sharia, punishing the oppressor is a necessary step for the betterment of society.

Homeland, to England, which is under the occupation of Britain, on this day we want to create a spirit of freedom-seeking that resides in the heartbeat of every human being and fights for justice, for the whole world is not for sale.
871.left:
In return for this, every Afghan, every Pashtun, and every human being must, on this day, raise their voice in unison for their freedom and independence against British colonialism, so that the grip of this oppressive system may be removed and the banner of truth and justice may be raised. On this day, the demand of all of us is that the era of force and oppression must end, and respect for human rights must be upheld.

On this day, we bow our heads in support of those oppressed who live under tyranny and despotism. We must understand that as long as an oppressed person exists on this earth, the chain of the oppressor's injustices will continue. So, let us join hands in unity on this day and prepare for the sacred struggle on the path of truth.

The message of this day is that demanding justice, struggling against oppression, and supporting the oppressed is the duty of each one of us, and any sacrifice in this path is a guarantee of our future victory.

(Fifth, 34, September 1921)

In our previous issue, at the very top of the first page of "Pashtun", an error occurred in place of the word "Muslim", which is why the hearts of many respected Muslims were pained, and some had even expressed severe displeasure. Regarding this error of ours, the apology is such that: When we were proofreading the first page of "Pashtun" from the printing press's side, we saw the letter "Malsman" instead of "Muslim", but we had given the printing press an order to correct it, however, due to the carelessness of the printing press workers or machine errors, this error still remained, and this is not due to our carelessness, but rather the result of an incorrect operational error by the printing press. We apologize to our respected readers in this regard and will make every effort to prevent the repetition of this error. On behalf of the editorial board of "Pashtun".

In the previous issue, in the headline of "Pashtun", the word "Muslim" was printed as "Malsman", and because of this error, we sincerely apologize to our respected Muslims, and we hope that they will forgive us for this small error. This error was not made intentionally, but rather it was a technical error during printing. The administration of "Pashtun" will clearly explain this matter by correcting this error in its next issue.

894.right:
For several days, since this sign of humiliation came by God's will due to our misfortune, and we were ignorant of it while our hearts burned for the state of the country, we realize that these miseries have arisen because of our disunity. If, God forbid, we remain in this state of accepting this humiliation, then before God, we will be responsible for the ruin of our nation. Therefore, we must collectively begin our efforts to regain the progress and honor of the country.

Of our responsibilities

If this stock is a cause for spreading among other activists, then in reality, this is a great responsibility for those who instill the spirit of national unity among their compatriots. This is a task that must be performed with heart and full intelligence, because it is the greatest service for the pleasure of God.

The rights and duties of our sons and daughters

To protect the rights of our children, we must make efforts for their education and upbringing; this is not only for the future of the country, but also a duty to fulfill their human rights. If we want our children to serve the country in the future, then from today, we must follow Islamic and national values in their upbringing.
894.left:
There is a need for a national uprising to protect the honor of the country, so that we may free our nation from the clutches of colonialism and achieve independence. This is a task that every Afghan is proud of and must make sacrifices for in this path. The sacrifices of our past heroes must remain as a torch for all the inhabitants of the country.

Freedom

Freedom is not just liberation from slavery, but freedom is the right to independent thought, independent action, and the determination of one's own destiny. We must understand that valuing God-given blessings in freedom is the religious and national duty of every individual. Today, as we face a new world, we must protect our past historical heritage and become one hand for the prosperity of the country.

895.right:
There is no doubt that much has been written about the first issue of "Islah" magazine, which was published in Kabul. The role this magazine could play in promoting a new culture and raising public awareness is a discussion that holds great importance in the history of journalism itself.

The following points regarding "Islah" magazine are noteworthy:
1. Addressing social issues: This magazine attempts to shed light on the shortcomings of society.
2. Promoting education: In this magazine, an effort has been made to encourage people to learn by highlighting the importance of education.
3. Literary and historical value: Such publications are considered a good mirror of the development of language and literature of that time.

Since this magazine is an important page in the history of Afghanistan's press, its preservation and study are a source of pride for every Afghan.
895.left:
Reformative issues

I consider this magazine (Islah), belonging to my dear friend Mr. Faiz Mohammad Khan, who has dedicated his entire life to the progress of Afghans, as a new light. This magazine is not only a fulfiller of the demands of the time, but it is also a guide for those who are in search of the prosperity of the homeland.

In my opinion, Islah is not just a collection of lines on sheets of paper, but the birth of a new thought that must be read with care. I personally wish for the further success of this magazine and respect all those who work for this goal.

With God's farewell,
(Rayan Hamadshah)

In the process of building a new village in the wilderness away from their village, the people of this village set such new stages for mutual help and cooperation that they created a new example of pride and brotherhood for other Pashtun villagers. These opinions emphasize that the medical profession is a sacred profession and in it, the goal of saving human life should be prioritized over material gains, because human life is more valuable than anything else.

900.right: When religion enters into life, the actions it takes for the improvement of human life are as follows: First, it instills the belief in the oneness of God Almighty in the human mind in such a way that there is no room for doubt or suspicion, and this is the very belief that provides a path for the human soul and self that is free from the whispers of Satan and occupied with the pleasure of God. And then, it teaches the lesson of living according to the way of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), which is the path of salvation for humanity, in which there is a great wisdom, and this very wisdom becomes the cause of a great revolution in human life. And this is a truth that illuminates the face of every wise person, and shows them that the path taught in this book is a great path for every human being that cleanses them of their sins and sets them on the path of righteousness. And this is also the path that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) spread among his followers and planted the seed of faith in their hearts, and that seed then turned into a great tree whose shade became a cause of mercy for the entire world.
900.left:
Summary of the religion
Discussion: The life of Muslims during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was so brilliant through this book that they were free from all kinds of evil and corruption, and this life is a great example for today's Muslims. If Muslims today want to find a position of honor and prosperity in their lives, then it is necessary for them to follow the path of their Prophet's Sunnah and the guidance of the Quran, because the secret of success in this world and the hereafter lies in this. In this current era, where Muslims are facing all kinds of difficulties, their only way is to hold firmly to this religion and to fully act upon the commands of Allah Almighty, so that the help of Allah may come to them.

901.right: Suppose a person completes the recitation of the entire Quran, would he not be aware of what is in practice? Just like a man who was recommended by someone in the market to recite a new book, so he started reciting it with great love, just as someone reads a new book for knowledge, but there are many sins in this; however, when he was asked what this book is for and what is written in it, he was unaware. So, this means that there should be knowledge in religion and what is written in it; if we understand this, it will be for the reform of our lives, because the Holy Quran is a book of guidance, not just that we recite it and remain involved in our sins. We must protect ourselves from this and reflect on it; the commandments of Allah Almighty are present in it, so the knowledge of this is necessary for every Muslim, and all this is in this book, so it is necessary for us to understand the meaning of the Holy Quran and implement it in our actions.
901.left: Likewise, if a person borrows something from someone and gives nothing in return, this act is against Sharia, and it is a major sin; therefore, in return for this, one must seek forgiveness from Allah Almighty and remain very firm in repentance, because Allah Almighty is merciful to His servants and accepts their repentance, provided that they are remorseful for their sins and do not repeat that sin again, and in the future, they walk on the path of Allah Almighty, and align all the affairs of their life for the pleasure of Allah Almighty, and strive for the happiness of Allah Almighty with their own self and wealth, and do not consume the rights of other people and do not break anyone's heart; so by doing this, Insha'Allah, Allah Almighty will cover all his sins and grant him forgiveness, so it is necessary for every Muslim to strive in this path and make an effort for the reformation of his life.

902.right: In issue 15, we mentioned that certain matters regarding the essence and attributes of Allah Almighty, which are beyond the comprehension of human reason, must be believed in. This point is specifically for those who wish to measure everything on the scale of reason. They need to understand that reason is a limited thing. Just as there are many things in this universe that human reason cannot grasp, similarly, applying reason to the essence of Allah Almighty is futile. Such people who want to determine everything through reason are unaware of the Quran and Sunnah. Whereas, in many places in the Holy Quran, matters of the unseen are mentioned, and believing in them is mandatory for believers. The attribute of believers is precisely that they believe in the unseen and know that the knowledge of Allah Almighty is above all else. Accordingly, they do not ask questions about matters that are beyond reason, but rather believe in them blindly. Such behavior causes the strengthening of a person's faith and keeps their heart pure from other sins and doubts. In conclusion, we must say that reflecting on the attributes of Allah Almighty is a way to recognize His greatness, but delving into the nature of His essence is useless and a sign of the weakness of human reason. Therefore, it is necessary for every Muslim to have firm faith in this and to acknowledge the limitations of their own reason.
902.left: It is not the case that everything is measured by the scale of reason; for example, the reality of the soul, the nature of Hell and Paradise, and the various accounts of the events of the Day of Judgment are all matters that do not fall within the scope of our reason. If someone wants to weigh all of these on the scale of reason, they will fail in the process. For this purpose, Allah Almighty has sent prophets to inform people about these truths. The word of the prophets is the word of Allah Almighty, and accepting it is obligatory for everyone. Besides this, the commandments of Allah Almighty are sometimes such that human reason cannot fully grasp their wisdom, but the duty of a believer is to accept them. For example, in acts of worship, there are some matters whose apparent wisdom is not known, but the essence of servitude lies in performing them. Therefore, based on this, using reason in matters of religion is necessary to help in fulfilling the commandments, not to criticize them. Every Muslim should align their life according to the guidance of the Quran and the Prophetic Sunnah and protect themselves from all kinds of doubts and temptations.

903.right:
The truth is that the human mind is affected by what people hear and see, and by such words that cause a change in the human heart. Therefore, in the context of explaining the effect of reciting the Holy Quran, Allah Almighty has stated: "And when the Quran is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy." In light of this noble verse, to educate people, we also present some points regarding the etiquette of reciting and listening to the Holy Quran. First, the etiquette of reciting the Holy Quran is: First, purity of heart and sincerity of intention are very necessary for recitation. It is necessary for a person, when reciting the Holy Quran, to empty their heart of all worldly thoughts and recite solely for the pleasure of Allah Almighty, because Allah Almighty has stated that the deeds of servants depend on their intentions. Second, the recitation of the Holy Quran should be done with great politeness and respect; during recitation, there should be a feeling of the greatness and majesty of Allah Almighty in the person's heart, and they should recite with great peace and dignity. Third, during recitation, one should contemplate and reflect on the meanings of the Holy Quran so that the message of the Holy Quran can be properly understood and one's life can be aligned in its light, because the Holy Quran is not only for recitation but also for action.

Likewise, the etiquette of listening to the Holy Quran is also very important: First, during listening, one should pay attention to the Holy Quran with all their heart and avoid other conversations and distractions, because the Holy Quran is the word of Allah Almighty and listening to it is at the level of worship. Second, during listening, one should sit in an atmosphere of politeness and respect and listen with great attention, because the word of Allah Almighty is worthy of greatness and value. Third, by listening, one should act upon the commandments of the Holy Quran, because the benefit of listening lies in the fact that a person acts upon the commandments of Allah Almighty.

904.right: It is a necessary command for Muslims. When God Almighty commanded Muslims for the stability of His religion and for its propagation that they should always dedicate human life for the sake of the religion's requirements, and that unity is for the success of the religion and for the elimination of their [problems], and for the sake of unity and companionship, education and the propagation of the religion, human conditions should be directed towards improvement and reform, which is a great service to the religion and a great step towards reform, then God Almighty, for the propagation of this religion, whatever was necessary, placed everything in it for His pleasure and for the honor of the religion.

913.right:
Clarifications on the Day of New Intercession:
Question: Does intercession exist?
Answer: Yes, intercession exists and is proven by the consensus of the scholars of the Ummah. According to the Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, the intercession of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) for sinners is a truth, and this intercession is for those who have died in a state of faith and have not repented for their sins. Allah Almighty, by His grace, grants His Prophet (PBUH) permission to intercede so that he may intercede for his Ummah.
Question: Who is intercession needed for on the Day of Judgment?
Answer: According to the belief of the Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, intercession is for those believers who obeyed Allah (SWT) and His Messenger (PBUH) in this world, and who would be deserving of punishment on the Day of Judgment due to their sins; Allah Almighty removes their punishment through the intercessors.
Question: Is intercession performed for all people?
Answer: No, it is stated in the Holy Quran that for the oppressors there will be no friend or intercessor whose word will be accepted; this means that disbelievers and polytheists are not eligible for intercession. Intercession is only for those who have died upon the word of Tawhid (monotheism).
913.left:
In conclusion, we must say that intercession (Shafa'at) is a matter that we must believe in; it is a sign of Allah Almighty's mercy that He has ordained for the forgiveness of His servants. However, we must remember that intercession cannot replace a person's deeds. Every human being must attain the pleasure of Allah Almighty by performing good deeds in this world, and the hope of intercession should be for those who have observed the commandments of Allah (SWT) in their lives.
Question: Will the intercession of the Prophet (PBUH) be for all sinners?
Answer: The intercession of the Prophet (PBUH) is for the major sinners of his Ummah who have died in a state of faith. This intercession is for those who are in punishment due to their sins; by the blessing of this intercession, Allah Almighty will save them from punishment and admit them into Paradise. This is an important part of the Islamic creed that we must believe in.
Question: What prevents intercession?
Answer: Disbelief (Kufr), polytheism (Shirk), and having doubt or skepticism regarding the commandments of religion are obstacles to intercession. Allah Almighty has stated in the Quran that He does not grant intercession to those with whom He (SWT) is not pleased. Therefore, we must arrange our lives in such a way that we become worthy of Allah Almighty's pleasure, so that we may be deserving of intercession on the Day of Judgment.

This law, known as the British Republic Act, came into being as a result of the demands and struggle of the people of India that had been started by the people of India over the past few years. This law was considered an important step towards fulfilling those demands of the people of India.

Based on this draft, the British accepted that Afghanistan would conduct its affairs independently and that they would not interfere in its internal affairs at all. This draft had been signed in the form of a treaty between Amir Abdur Rahman Khan and the British government in 1880, based on which the British worked to expand their influence in Afghanistan. However, in the present time, due to ignorance of Islamic teachings, a large void is seen in the lives of Muslims, which is the major cause of the decline of our civilization. If we want to regain the pride of the former glory of our civilization, then we must strive to implement those principles of Islamic morals which are embedded in the blessed teachings of our great guide (PBUH) and in his (PBUH) pure life. It is necessary for every Muslim to pay attention to the morals of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) in their daily affairs.
923.left: In this section, with the aim of reviving this civilization, some important points have been highlighted. For a Muslim, it is an unforgivable mistake to remain unaware of the values of their own civilization. A major cause of our current fragmented life is that we have kept ourselves away from those moral principles that were the secret to the greatness of our ancestors. In the history of Islamic civilization, we see that whenever Muslims achieved excellence in the field of morality, they also remained world leaders in the fields of science and art. However, today, due to this weakness, our life is moving on a path whose result appears only in the form of discord and chaos. Therefore, it is necessary to think seriously about this and take specific steps for moral education. Merely mentioning Islamic civilization in words is not enough; rather, by putting it into practice, this change must be brought about in the life of every Muslim so that the true face of Islamic civilization may shine once again on the face of the world.

924.right:
Circumstances
Every nation needs a distinct way to preserve its history so that the causes of its progress and decline can be determined. Although the history of Islam begins with the advent of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), Allah Almighty has made such arrangements through heavenly books for the circumstances of his blessed life that there is no more reliable information about anyone else. This path is the Prophetic Sunnah, in which every word and action of his life is preserved. If we consider both these paths of history and Sunnah, we realize that at the beginning of every era of Islam, Allah Almighty has created individuals who have worked for the protection of the religion and the reformation of the people.
If we study the history of India, from Akbar to Aurangzeb, and after him, from the decline of Islam to the beginning of the new era, many such events come to light that are a place of reflection for every Muslim. The 'Din-i-Ilahi' that was created during Akbar's time, and the many events that occurred after that until the era of Aurangzeb, brought a very great change in the lives of Muslims. In this regard, the achievements of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi are worth mentioning, for the path he adopted to end the corruption of his time and his efforts to breathe a new spirit into the hearts of Muslims.
924.left:
The new era and our responsibilities
This is a fact that no one can turn a blind eye to. If we look at this book of past history, it becomes clear to us that in every era of Islam, Muslims faced a challenge that was a time of testing for their faith and the teachings of Islam. The era in which we live today is an era of knowledge and scientific advancement. The demand of this new era is that we find answers to the problems of today's era in the light of the principles of our religion.
It is a very great responsibility for us to take lessons from our past history and create a path for the future in which there is a balance between Islamic ethics and modern sciences. In this regard, it is the duty of scholars and intellectuals to present a roadmap for Muslims that ensures success for them in both this world and the hereafter. If we learn from our past history, it will be a very big step for the glory of Islam.

Regarding the story of this liberation from slavery, this point was very important: that a slave who is in the hands of such a powerful Pharaoh who claims divinity, his salvation from his hands was certainly the result of God's help.

Pashto and ways for its development:
For the growth and development of the Pashto language, a joint effort should be made among scholars, writers, and language enthusiasts that will lead to the comprehensive development of the language. For the growth of the language, writing literary pieces, publishing books, and organizing literary gatherings are very necessary. Along with this, efforts to standardize the language should be accelerated, and the advice of scholars should be utilized to remove any obstacles in this path.

The role of media, educational institutions, and literature faculties must be increased in the path of language development. For the development of the Pashto language, policies should be adopted that ensure the comprehensive progress of the language as a result, so that the Pashto language stands in the ranks of other developed languages of the world. We must try to view Pashto as a scientific and literary language and take tireless steps for its strengthening.

If we provide such an environment for the young generation to study Pashto in which the language is worked upon in its modern form, then this will be a major step for the future of Pashto.

Pashto is a language with a rich historical background, and in this regard, more research work is needed in the field of its literature and linguistics.

939.left: It is necessary to mention a few important points regarding economics. Economics is not just the name of material gain, but a fundamental necessity for the order of human society and the improvement of life's affairs. In ancient times, with the growth of trade, the need for the science of economics also arose. With the emergence of money, the methods of transaction between people changed. Economists believe that for the progress of every nation, its resources must be utilized properly. If we want to be owners of a strong economy, then we must seek new ways and means in the light of science and knowledge. Maintaining a balance between industry and agriculture is a condition for the flourishing of the economy. Furthermore, raising the standard of living of the common people and establishing a fair distribution system to eradicate poverty is the duty of every government.

940.right:
Issues of Nikah (Marriage)

The rights of a woman that have been ordained by Allah (SWT) are as follows:
First: The right to Mahr (dowry). Nikah is concluded with Mahr, and it is mandatory for the husband to give Mahr to his wife.
Second: If Mahr is determined in the Nikah and then the husband lives separately for a period or is unable to pay the Mahr, then according to Islamic Sharia, it is the woman's right to receive her Mahr. If the husband dies, the woman's Mahr is paid first from his remaining estate.
Third: In the husband's absence, the wife's maintenance and the upbringing of the children are the husband's responsibility. If the husband is on a journey or missing from home, the expenses for the wife and children must be paid from his assets.
Fourth: Protecting the honor and dignity of the wife is the husband's duty. It is necessary for the husband to live with his wife in kindness and fulfill her rights completely.
Fifth: The woman's right to inheritance, which is established in the Book of Allah (SWT), no one has the permission to trample upon this right. If the husband passes away, the wife has her fixed share in his remaining inheritance.
Sixth: If there is a dispute between the husband and wife, then according to Sharia, the decision between them must be made with justice and fairness.
940.left:
Seventh: If a wife requests a divorce from her husband, then her rights must be considered and her dowry (Mahr) must be paid in full.
Eighth: Raising and nurturing children is not solely the wife's duty; rather, the husband is also responsible for this. Joint effort by the husband and wife is necessary for the proper upbringing of children.
Ninth: At the time of marriage, witnesses must be present so that they may bear witness to the marriage contract and protect each other's rights.
Tenth: The wife's family rights, which are rooted in Pashtun culture and Islamic principles, must be respected by the husband, and he should not commit injustice against her.
In conclusion, we must say that the purpose of an Islamic marriage is to build a pure society in which love, sympathy, and respect for each other's rights exist.

What the Almighty has said: (If you do not do so, then be warned of a war from Allah and His Messenger), meaning if you do not abandon interest, then prepare for war from Allah and His Messenger. This verse is very strong regarding the prohibition of interest. If someone is engaged in the business of interest and has not repented, they are prepared for war from Allah and His Messenger. This is a very great and dangerous war. May the Almighty God protect us from this great sin and may He grant us repentance from interest. Amen.

Ninety-five points of benefit:
When Islam views interest with prohibition, it has a great wisdom. Interest is in conflict with the philosophy of Islam that strengthens the spirit of brotherhood and cooperation among the members of society. Interest causes the concentration of wealth and leads to further poverty for the poor. It hinders the progress of humanity and divides society into two parts: one of those who possess all the wealth, and the other of those who do not even have the basic necessities of life. In the Sharia of Islam, one of the goals of the Zakat and charity system is that the circulation of wealth should be among all classes of society.
941.left: And instead of interest, (Qard-e-Hasana) and such methods of trade have been taught in which there is benefit for the society. Interest is an important cause for the destruction of the foundations of the economic system, because in the interest-based system, labor and hard work are not valued; rather, money is obtained in exchange for money, which is an act against social justice. If we want to have a successful society, then we must save ourselves from the evil system of interest and develop our transactions in the light of the Islamic economic system. For this, it is necessary to acquire knowledge of Islamic moral and economic laws and to resolve to save ourselves from the curse of interest for the sake of God Almighty's pleasure in our daily affairs. May the grace of Allah Almighty be with us so that we may be successful in performing this duty.

The second stage of Pashtun's journey

Thanks be to Allah that after six and a half years of separation and the patience-testing wait of the great mother of Rome, "Pashtun" once again has the honor of reaching the hands of its dear readers. This was not the first stage of Pashtun's separation; rather, as is known to many of our readers, once before the cruelty of time had come between us and Pashtun, because of Pashtun's immortal voice of truth and honesty. First, the arrogant forces of falsehood also appeared in the field of opposition. This time, too, the dark and terrifying forces of tyranny, like the sun's rays on the blue sky of time, are shining—Pashtun was first published nearly ten years ago in April 1928 as a monthly magazine—it had traveled for two years and one month on the sea of politics with its scientific, reformist, and political ship—when the storm of revolution brought a ban on it and it was forced into a hiatus. That is, the issue of 23 April 1930 was its issue, and the preparation for May was underway, when on 23 April, the owner and director of Pashtun, Fakhr-e-Afghan Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, was arrested along with his companions and was put inside the gates of the Gujrat Special Jail for three years. Peace was established between the government and the public. Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib and other political prisoners were released. "Pashtun" also resumed its journey after a month and a half, following the peace. The world knows that in its first era, Pashtun had brought a global revolution to the mind of the Pashtun public. So, in the second instance, it took a greater part in the Khudai Khidmatgar organization. Eight months of imprisonment had passed in that state. Finally, in December and January, the manuscript was sent to the printing press, but then a conflict and rift occurred between the public and the government, Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib and all other political workers were arrested, so Pashtun was forced to leave the field of journalism again and the printing was stopped. For almost six years, Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib was imprisoned and detained in other provinces of India, far from his beloved homeland. Here, there were strict restrictions on printing presses and newspapers, and Pashtun could not be published. Finally, in the last months of last year, Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib received permission to return to the homeland. And along with that, the authority of the provincial government also came into the hands of the national ministry. So, once again, the opportunity arose for Pashtun to enter the field of action and continue its service.
Although the effort to publish Pashtun had started six months ago, every task that the bureaucratic government considers its own, it does not easily grant permission for. So, a lot of time passed in obtaining permission. Finally, this stage was also passed. Now, the issue of Pashtun is presented to the nation in the form of a ten-day newspaper instead of a monthly magazine.
The question arises, what will Pashtun do? What is its policy? Regarding others, it will be enough to say this - that Pashtun does not have commercial interests in mind, nor is any financial gain its purpose. Its first [goal] was also the awakening of the nation, the progress of the country.

The Khudai Khidmatgar Movement and its affairs
(From Fakhr-e-Afghan Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan)

Dear Pashtun brothers! I have always explained the main objectives of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement to you in clear words in my speeches. Nothing is hidden or secret. However, it may happen that there are some of my brothers who have not had the opportunity to hear my speeches, or perhaps they have heard the speeches but have not understood their meaning, or perhaps they have understood them but, upon hearing the words of others, doubts have arisen in their hearts. So today, through my newspaper "Pashtun," I want to speak once again in clear, plain words regarding the goal of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement I have launched. And through these words, I want to ask you all: for what purpose was this movement started? What will be its result? And who will benefit from it?

Dear brothers! God Almighty has a system, and His power is based on a complete law. From the time He created the world and spread the children of Adam (peace be upon him) across the world, He has made the world famous as different nations for different statuses and inhabitants, and He has given each nation a portion of the earth or a country.
957.left: is. And for the cultivation of this land or country, for the preservation of the independence of this country, and for the peace of the people of this country, they have created a law for themselves. God Almighty has created all these nations in the world so that they may help one another in their comfort. Not that one should see happiness for oneself in destroying another and in enslaving another. So when this is the state of the nations of the world, then why are the Pashtuns separate from these nations of the world? And why was the need for the Khudai Khidmatgar movement felt among the Pashtuns? Listen to this matter carefully, that in the past, a time had come upon the Pashtuns when the independence of the Pashtuns had ended. The Pashtuns were bound in the chains of slavery. And other powerful nations of the world had divided the land of the Pashtuns among themselves. The Pashtuns themselves were under the feet of foreigners in their own home country. From the Pashtuns, their honor, their wealth, their children, and their God were lost in this slavery. A state had emerged among the Pashtuns where unity and brotherhood among them had ended. One Pashtun had become a means of destruction for another. To end this slavery and bad state, this thought arose in my heart that the Pashtuns must free themselves from this bad state of theirs. And regain their God-given freedom. So that is why I started the Khudai Khidmatgar movement. And the purpose of this movement of mine was only this, that Pashtuns should share in each other's grief and take each other's hand and free themselves from these chains of slavery and regain the freedom of their homeland. So my dear ones! This is the main purpose of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement, that Pashtuns must once again recognize themselves and make sacrifices for the freedom of their homeland.

Death in life is the reason why a person maintains honor, dignity, and prestige in front of others, because in their absence, things are said about their life's work that they would not have had the patience to hear while alive. There are different types of death, and every person's reaction to death is also different. Various opinions have also been expressed by scholars and researchers regarding death. Death is that eternal and unchangeable reality of life from which no one can escape; every human being thinks about the fear of death or this reality during their life.

Death is such an event in a human's life that all things of their existence disappear into the mouth of death at once, yet human opinions about death are different. Some humans view death as a liberation, while others consider death the end of life and fear it. In reality, death is such a point in a human's life that it causes all of a person's affairs to come to an end, and their entire life story concludes with death.

When we discuss the thoughts and opinions of scholars regarding this, we realize that humans have never remained of one opinion regarding death. Human views on life have changed at different times, but the reality of death has never changed. In the same way, by studying the opinions of scholars regarding the fear of death or any kind of thought about it, we reach the conclusion that humans think a lot about life in the face of the fear of death.

The goal of my path is to raise the awareness of the people and protect the interests of the homeland. If I were to give up my efforts because of people's bad words and taunts, then this would be an act of disloyalty toward my independence and my love for the homeland. My efforts are for all those who work with a sincere heart for the progress of the country and the improvement of education and training; my path is the path of truth, and I will remain on this path until the very end.

The reason for the decline of the morals, religious, and national sentiments of Muslims in all their worldly, social, and revolutionary affairs in the current time is that the habit of imitating others has developed in everything we do. This does not mean that we should keep ourselves unaware of the blessings of modern science and art; rather, it means that we accept everything coming towards us from others, assuming it to be a means of progress and religious life, without thinking about its benefits or harms. News of the Ghurfan region

News of the days of the Ghurfan region

On April 8, 1920, a large gathering of the people of the Ghurfan region was held. Hundreds of people from the region participated in this meeting. In this meeting, first of all, Sahib Khan of Ghurfan spoke with his people about the problems of the region. He said that the people of the area are facing many difficulties and want the government to find a solution to their problems. After Sahib Khan's speech, suggestions were also made by other leaders of the area for the development of the region and the establishment of peace in the area.

In this meeting, the people of the area emphasized the importance of unity and it was decided that a delegation would be formed to solve the problems of the area, which would convey the demands of the people of the area to the government. The meeting ended in the evening with a prayer.

During the course of his speech regarding the progress of the country, Mr. Ghaznavi spoke for the benefit of his meeting, stating that on the 9th of April, he held this meeting with his people in such a manner. In the course of the success of this meeting and Mr. Ghaznavi's speeches, the enthusiasm and passion of the people in this meeting, along with the thoughts of Mr. Ghaznavi and the participation of Khan Lala on that day, brought everyone together before the people for the sake of welcoming Khan Lala.

1049.right:
On the first of April, this meeting was held at Khan Sahib's house. The number of participants in this meeting was very large; people showered flowers over Khan Sahib, and this meeting was very magnificent. Upon hearing Khan Sahib's words, a flood of tears flowed from the people's eyes; the people had listened with great affection to his words. During his speech, Khan Sahib emphasized the importance of the struggle for his homeland's freedom and the rights of the people, and he invited the people to unite under the umbrella of unity and brotherhood. Thanks to this meeting, a new spirit was born among the people of the region, and they firmly resolved to achieve independence.

After this meeting, it was decided to hold another meeting at Khan Sahib's house, in which other leaders of the region would also participate so that the people's problems and their solutions could be examined together. This meeting was a new, hopeful beginning for the people of the region.

1079.right:
Regarding rights

Rights are those which, throughout the course of history and with the progress of human civilization, first emerged in the form of individual rights, and then became customary among nations. These rights were very simple in the beginning, but as societies developed and relationships between humans expanded, the need for laws arose to protect these rights and establish justice. In this way, the science of law emerged as a civil necessity.

The sixteenth century, which was the century of the beginning of global transformations, was a time when legal scholars attempted to create new principles by analyzing ancient texts and in the light of rational arguments. The result of these efforts was that the science of law emerged from religious and traditional frameworks and took its place as an independent scientific discipline. In the structure of states, the role of the constitution and the courts for ensuring justice was strengthened.

Today, law is divided into two parts: public law and private law. Public law regulates the relationship between the state and citizens, while private law is established to regulate transactions, property, and family relationships between individuals. Law is the foundation of a society's order, stability, and justice, through which every human being's right is protected within a defined limit and the rule of law is guaranteed.

1110.left:
Prejudice and Fanaticism
By Mr. Syed Ali Jeka Shah Khan Khakwani
Principles of the subjects:-
(1) A group of people who are the children of one ancestor is called a "family" (khandan).
(2) A collection of these families is called a "tribe" (qabila).
(3) The status of a collection of families is called a "group" (jamaat).
(4) Whenever groups come together, it is termed a "nation" (qawm).
(5) When a nation lives in one homeland, speaks one language, shares one religion, and shares in solitude, then such a nation is a nation in the true sense.
(6) It is necessary that in every nation, there are individual, familial, tribal, and group differences, provided that national unity remains intact, and the binding force of this unity is a sentiment which in Arabic is called "asabiyyah" (fanaticism), and in Pashto it is called "rawi-wal" (solidarity).
(7) When this sentiment becomes excessive, it is called prejudice and Pashtun fanaticism, but if one nation holds prejudice against another nation, despite this, they do not call it a defect of the nation, but rather consider it a skill and take pride in it.
(8) Of course, if this defect of prejudice exists within families, tribes, or groups, then this is a bad thing, and it is called sectarianism.

A twenty-year history
Afghan diplomatic representation (embassy) by the free people of Kabul (1919 AD)
In accordance with this historical demand by the people of Kabul and the subsequent declaration of independence, an Afghan government delegation was appointed for diplomatic representation. This delegation, which consisted of the following three parts, began its work with full courage and determination:
(1) The goal of this delegation was to officially present the independence of the Afghan state to other countries of the world and to be recognized among them as an independent and free country.
(2) In cooperation with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to create policies so that Afghanistan's political position is strengthened at the international level and relations with neighboring countries are established on the basis of brotherhood and equality.
(3) Considering regional conditions and the political complexities of the time, to adopt a procedure for defending the rights of the Afghan nation in which the national interests of the country are protected and any kind of foreign interference is prevented.
In the course of the Afghan government's objectives, this diplomatic delegation presented its demands in various meetings with other countries in the region and their leaders, and expressed the will of the Afghans before them. To implement these tasks, a special procedure was established which was divided into the following parts:
A - Establishing a permanent commission for strengthening diplomatic relations to cooperate directly with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the sake of protecting the country's national interests.
B - Signing agreements with foreign countries in which Afghanistan's independence and territorial integrity are recognized.
C - Arranging a regular schedule for meetings with those foreign ambassadors and representatives who wish to establish official relations with the Afghan government and discuss matters of mutual interest.
1122.left:
Journal page 29
This diplomatic delegation faced some challenges at the beginning of its work, because the colonial powers of the region were trying to protect their interests regarding Afghanistan, but the Afghan delegation succeeded in removing these obstacles thanks to their determination and national unity. While presenting their demands, they took a stance as representatives of the Afghan nation that showed the world that Afghanistan is a historical and civilized country that fights to the end for its freedom. Another important part of this delegation's activities was related to promoting the legitimacy of Afghanistan's independence through the media, through which they were able to gain significant support from the people of the world. Besides this, the participation of Afghan representatives in various international meetings caused the voice of the Afghan government to reach the ears of the countries of the world and demand justice regarding their rights. This historical action is considered the beginning of a new era in the history of Afghan diplomacy, which laid the foundation for the future progress and prosperity of the country. In this process, the individuals appointed by the government also performed their duties with honesty and did not spare any effort in the way of fulfilling the hopes of their people.

1147.right:
Two years ago

With the intention of perfuming the minds of its readers with the fragrance of the flowers of this flourishing garden of "Pashtun" newspaper, and in the series of printing its opening pages, to celebrate the one-year anniversary of the publication of the first issue of "Pashtun", and in the series of printing and publishing the special edition of the first issue of the second year of "Pashtun", it offers heartfelt congratulations to the fans of "Pashtun". This is the beginning of the first issue of the second year of "Pashtun", which is another step for the full recognition of the results of the comprehensive efforts and endeavors of the first year of printing and publishing, and for celebrating the historical and national role of "Pashtun" in the promotion of the Pashto language and the spread of unity and brotherhood among Pashtuns, and for the encouragement of the proud and heroic Pashtuns of Pashtunkhwa and the further strengthening of the national uprising.

We hope that this second year of "Pashtun" will be as colorful as its flowers and, thanks to the pens of its writers, will shine like a bright torch in the path of the flourishing of the Pashto language and literature and the national unity of the Pashtuns, and will keep the spirit of Pashtunwali even more alive in the hearts of its fans.
1147.left: Regarding this special issue of the first edition of the second year of "Pashtun," I must say that I thank all my friends and contributors for printing this issue, who have worked shoulder to shoulder with me in this endeavor and have spared no effort for the beauty and vibrancy of this issue. This issue is an example of the creative works of young and new writers of Pashtunkhwa and the enrichment of Pashto language literature, which is considered an important step for the national unity of the Pashtuns and the pride of the Pashtuns.

1148.right:
Pashtun heroes
Many such people have passed through this country who have served God's creation with their swords, but Shah Wali Khan's services are distinguished and separate from all of them. Shah Wali Khan was the person who served the homeland at the cost of his own life with great indifference. He was among those people who, with great bravery, put his life in danger to protect the honor and dignity of this country. He stood firm like a mountain against the tyrants of the time and never bowed his head before anyone. This was a sign of his courage and zeal that he would stand as a leader in every difficulty of the homeland.
1148.left:
Hero of the Afghan 28
Just as there is no doubt that the entire nation is plunged into grief over the news of Shah Wali Khan's death. He was a person who had made serving the homeland the purpose of his life at all times. Shah Wali Khan was recognized not only as a hero but also as a guide who always strove for the welfare and improvement of the people. His death is a great loss for the homeland. It is the work of God Almighty that death comes to every human being, but those who dedicate their lives to their homeland, their names remain eternal. Shah Wali Khan was one of those people who had taken a place in the hearts of the people through his character and actions. His memory will always be alive in the hearts of Afghans.

It is like a power in the life of a nation that is a strong and essential component in the life of a society. A nation that does not have freedom of opinion among itself can never progress morally or materially. In order for our society to take steps towards progress, it is necessary to respect each other under the pretext of protecting freedom of expression. For a strong society, it is very necessary that legal frameworks be established to ensure freedom of opinion.
1205.left: In this section, it must be kept in mind that freedom of opinion does not mean insulting others, but rather that everyone has the right to express their opinion respectfully. Islamic teachings also show us that listening to each other's opinions leads to an increase in wisdom and knowledge. Since today we are at a stage where the speed of information exchange is very high, the sense of responsibility regarding freedom of opinion has increased to the same extent. With the participation of all, we can build a society in which every individual's opinion is valued and an atmosphere of unity and brotherhood prevails. In conclusion, we can say that freedom of opinion should be recognized not only as a right, but also as a moral responsibility, and joint efforts should be made to protect it.

Czechoslovakia is a country in Central Europe that borders Poland and Germany to the north, Austria and Hungary to the south, Romania to the east, and Germany to the west. The Republic of Czechoslovakia was officially formed in 1918 after the end of the First World War. The center of the Czechoslovak government is Prague, which is considered one of the oldest and most beautiful cities in the world. This country is of great importance in its geography and political structure. The people of Czechoslovakia are two major ethnic groups called Czechs and Slovaks, who have historically lived together. This country is also very advanced in terms of industry and culture and has a special position in Central European politics.

The history of Czechoslovakia is full of events and changes, which has occupied a special place in the history of Europe. Currently, this country is moving towards progress and is known among the international community for its industrial products and cultural values.

Since one considers their own self (nafs) as their own enemy, because it is always following its own desires against the commands of God (J), this very self is the origin of a human's happiness or misery. If a human gains control over their self and guides it in the light of their intellect and Sharia, then in reality, they become the owner of great successes; and if they drown in the desires of their self, then they become the owner of humiliation and misery in this world and the hereafter. This martyr of ours is also a great example of the sacrifice of these self-desires in the path of God (J), and the fact that he reached the status of martyrdom on the battlefield was the result of his good and great deeds, through which he became the owner of eternal life and honor in this world and the hereafter.
Ah! This path of self-sacrifice that this martyr found is a clear sign of his faith and piety. He stood in the field against the enemy with such courage that he cared neither for his head nor for his life; rather, in his heart, he had only the thought of God's (J) pleasure and the exaltation of His religion. This spirit of martyrdom of his brought eternal pride and happiness to his family, and his name was written in golden lines on the pages of history.
This martyr, who gave his life for the protection of his homeland and religion, is in reality an example for every Pashtun, who should take a lesson from his bravery and steadfastness in their own actions and fight against their own self with such determination and courage.
1234.left:

If we want to be successful in every part of our lives, we must follow in the footsteps of the martyrs and sacrifice our own desires for the pleasure of God (SWT). In this lies the good of every human being in this world and the hereafter, and in this very path lies the way of honor and greatness for every Pashtun.
This blood of the martyrs, which has been shed in the path of truth, is an example of a new light and a new hope that will keep the path of truth bright for future generations as well. We must understand that martyrdom is not just giving one's life, but the name of a sacrifice of a life in which all the desires of one's self are sacrificed for the pleasure of God (SWT).

Last week, when a meeting was organized by a number of scholars from the time of Ghazi Amanullah Khan for the awakening of the people of Pashtunkhwa, a decision was made for a great struggle for the freedom of Pashtunkhwa. Many leaders and brave youths from the regions of Pashtunkhwa participated in this meeting. The meeting was chaired by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, who began his speech during the meeting by stating that the awakening of the Pashtun nation is our primary duty. He said that we must break the chains of foreign slavery and unite for independence.

At the end of the meeting, the policy of Ghazi Amanullah Khan was praised, and it was decided that people from every region of Pashtunkhwa would gather for freedom and work to achieve their goal through a joint organization. It was also decided to form a committee under the leadership of Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, which would control all the affairs of this movement.

In the end, the participants of the meeting pledged that they would sacrifice their lives for the freedom of Pashtunkhwa and would continue the struggle for the dignity of their homeland until the very end. The closing ceremony of the meeting was held with a prayer, and all participants returned to their regions with a new resolve.

1271.right: What was written in the previous issue regarding the People's Revolution was a harbinger of such a dangerous outcome for all of us, which clearly and plainly shows us that if we become victims of others' discord and ill intent, the result for us will be nothing but destruction and ruin. On the other hand, it is also necessary to mention regarding this subject that there are certain causes for the emergence of this revolution that had been hidden among the people for a long time. It is understandable for everyone that when a government turns a blind eye to the rights of its people and uses the path of oppression and force against them, then with the arrival of that time, the signs of that government's decline and fall also appear. It is also important that if a government does not take any concrete steps for the welfare and peace of its people, then the path is paved for the emergence of people's hatred and dissatisfaction, and this in itself is a sign of that government's weakness and failure, which paves the way for the end of its power.
1271.left: Adopting a policy for the nation that becomes a cause for the people's prosperity and progress is very essential for every government. If a government does not strive to protect the rights of its people, there is a possibility of a reaction emerging among the people that paves the way for social chaos and disorder. Therefore, it is necessary for every ruler to have a full understanding of their people's hopes and demands and to take steps for them that lead to the creation of public trust and their well-being. In conclusion, it must be said that establishing a just system for the happiness of the people and the protection of their rights is a priority for every government, and this is very important for their continuity and survival.

1272.right:
Peshawar: 12 August 1920 AD

Editorial Note

International Trade

Trade is a major factor in improving mutual relations among the world's people and in helping one another for mutual benefit. If the people of one country hinder the interests of the people of other countries for their own gain, they are in reality creating a major obstacle in the path of global progress and prosperity. All the people of the world are like one family; if an individual helps another, it is a humanitarian and moral act, but if someone goes against the interests of another for their own gain, it is an act against humanity. Our dear country, Afghanistan, is situated in a geographical location that can become a major trade hub between Central Asia and India, but our traders must understand that they should observe the principles of honesty and mutual assistance in trade, because the essence of trade is to fulfill people's needs, not just to make a profit.

Recently, reports of improper actions by some people in the field of trade have been received from certain areas, which is a matter of shame for all Afghans. We must understand that our country's economy is linked to trade, and if traders are not honest, the country's reputation is tarnished. It is the responsibility of every Afghan to use honesty in their dealings and strive for the progress of their country.

These atrocities are beyond endurance, and the government must think deeply about these actions of its own, as to how dangerous these actions are for the survival of the government. If the government wants to rule in this land with peace and security, it must take steps to solve these problems of the cultivator.

Pashtun Atlasgi -- 41

Martyr of the Homeland

Freedom is one of God's greatest blessings, which is the charming beauty and the radiance of life in the world. Regarding the value of this blessing and its preservation, the pages of history are colored with the blood of many brave and self-sacrificing heroes. Those heroes who sacrificed their lives and wealth to win their freedom, in order to protect the honor and dignity of the country.

Today, as we are under the shadow of this great blessing, it is all the result of the sacrifice of those martyrs who have fought for the freedom of their homeland. Giving one's life for the love of the homeland is a status that not everyone can attain, and only those who have come forward to serve the homeland in the light of faith achieve this honor.

We must understand that the homeland is a trust, and protecting this trust is the duty of every one of us Afghans. Self-sacrifice in the path of the homeland is the work of someone who has spent their life with true love and sincerity. Those martyrs who have sacrificed themselves in the path of the country's freedom will always remain alive in the pages of history.

1291.right:
The delay of "Pashtun"

As much as we try for "Pashtun" to be published on time and not be a single day late from the scheduled date, so that no one gets an opportunity to complain, unfortunately, due to bad luck or coincidence, every time an unexpected reason arises that forces us to be unable to succeed in our intentions.
Firstly, there is the irregularity of our office, due to which we could not publish it on time. And from within, the scribe's illness caused the delay. At first, we hoped that the scribe would recover in a day or two and continue his work, but until today, he has not been able to rest for two weeks. In this situation, the August 21 and July issues could not be published. If on one hand, we cannot lift our heads from shame before our readers, then on the other hand, we consider this loss a great shock to ourselves. It is hoped that the patrons of "Pashtun" will accept our excuse of compulsion and will not be upset.
(Editor)
