1292.right:
An article about public life

In these days when the lifestyles of many people in the world are changing, and world conditions are changing so rapidly that the inhabitants of many countries are making many changes in their past customs, it is necessary that we also think about the life of our nation. Unfortunately, there are some bad customs in our society that are not only obstacles to progress in our lives, but also cause the loss of our material and spiritual wealth. We must realize that any custom that does not align with Islamic rulings and the demands of the time should be reconsidered. For example, unnecessary expenses in wedding ceremonies, and actions during times of death and injury that are neither permissible from a religious perspective nor acceptable from a rational perspective, cause many families to be drowned in debt. The youth of our society, who are the pride of the future, must fight against such improper customs and organize their lives in the light of knowledge and wisdom. Likewise, the spirit of unity and brotherhood in society must be strengthened. We must not forget that the secret to the success of a nation lies only in unity and solidarity. If we want to live like other developed nations of the world, it is necessary that we look for our past shortcomings and strive to correct them.
1292.left:
A few points regarding the pen and education

In the current era, the value of knowledge and wisdom is hidden from no one. Any nation that falls behind in the field of education will find the paths to progress closed to it. Regarding the power of the pen, it is said that it is greater than the power of the sword, because the pen can bring about a revolution in the thought and mind of a nation that cannot be achieved by swords. In our region, there are many obstacles in the way of promoting education, but we must understand that removing these obstacles is the duty of every one of us. It is also the responsibility of governments and academic societies to provide the environment for education. Fortunately, some efforts have recently begun to raise the level of people's knowledge. In our magazine, there have been many discussions on the importance of education, and it is hoped that our readers have been encouraged to move towards knowledge. Whenever a person learns to read and write, their way of viewing the world changes. They can distinguish between truth and falsehood. In conclusion, it must be said that the importance of education and the pen in the life of a nation is like the water of life; if this water dries up, the life of the nation will also perish. So let us use all our efforts in the path of knowledge and the pen and take steps for the progress of our country.

Speech of Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib

But dear sisters and sweet brothers! You are aware of why we have gathered here today. That is, this meeting is being held in memory of those brave youths of Takkar who shed their precious blood in the path of the freedom of Islam, the country, and the nation. You might think that this Takkar incident is something new. But this incident of Takkar is not a new game. Read the history of all free nations; you will see countless incidents of this kind in it. New reforms and provincial autonomy

"An essential part of the new reforms is provincial autonomy. The national leaders of India had been demanding this for a long time, and in 1918, a joint report by the Congress and the Muslim League was presented for this very reason.
"It is clear that the 1919 reforms were a prelude to India's self-governing government, and because these reforms were meant to be permanent, their practical market in the provinces diminished in light of both. Under the 1919 reforms, the freedom and powers of the provinces were dependent on the mercy of the center. At the center's will and whenever requested, the provinces' powers were taken away. The provincial government was legally and morally not authorized to question the center's orders; the province's powers were like those of a company agent. 1326.right:
August 1920

The Muslim League and the Poet

Allama Sheikh Muhammad Iqbal is a poet among Orientalists whose fame for excellence has transcended the borders of the subcontinent. If this matter is doubtful in anyone's view, then for the measure of the popularity and fame of his poetry, it is enough that the discussions held regarding his poems among the members of the Indian Society of Orientalists (Anjuman-e-Khawar Shanasan), and the praises bestowed by the Viceroy of India and the Governor of Punjab, are proof of this fact. Iqbal is such a poet in the court of Orientalists that he has opened the doors of scholarly and literary discussions among the world's Orientalists regarding his poetry.

We take great pride in the fact that a poet like Iqbal has been recognized as a great poet of our Islamic Ummah, and in his poetry, there is a spirit of reviving Islamic greatness and glory that awakens the passion of Islamic honor and unity in the heart of every Muslim. If we reflect deeply on Iqbal's poetry, it becomes clear that it contains very profound and scholarly content regarding the causes of the decline of Muslims, which in itself is a sign of his insight and understanding of the Ummah's pain. According to Iqbal's poetry, there is a need for such a revolution in the lives of Muslims that would change their path of life in the light of Islamic principles and enable them to succeed in competition with other nations of the world. Through his poetry, Iqbal has made such an effort to awaken the Muslims that it will remain alive forever in the pages of history, and under the influence of his thoughts, future generations will be able to find the way to regain their past glory.
1326.left:
August 1920

The main reasons for the decline of Muslims can be examined in the light of Iqbal's poetry. According to Iqbal, the biggest reason for the decline of Muslims is their distance from knowledge and wisdom and the forgetting of their own Islamic traditions. In his view, when the taste for studying the glorious past of a nation ends, the decline of that nation begins right there. In his poetry, Iqbal has provided such guidance regarding the unity of Muslims and the regaining of their moral and spiritual strength that it serves as a beacon for the Muslims of today. Iqbal says that for the progress of Muslims, a balance of knowledge of both religion and the world is necessary, and this balance brings such equilibrium to a person's personality that they can be successful in every field of life.

Through his poetry, Iqbal dreamed of creating a new generation that would stand on its own feet and, by holding its head high before other nations of the world, raise the flag of the greatness of Islamic civilization. Regarding his poetry, Iqbal says that his verse is not just a world of imagination, but a message for changing the world of reality that will serve as a guide for human life in every era.

(End)

21 August 1920

Question and Answer
Question: Regarding the health of which people should one consult their doctors, and from which people is it necessary to keep oneself hidden?

Answer: Those people who are in the grip of such diseases that doctors are unable to treat, such as types of lung diseases for which doctors are hopeless of a cure, it is necessary to avoid sitting and socializing with such people. Because the effects of this disease cause harm to the health of other people.

Oppression and Children
Question: If someone commits oppression against their children, what effect does it have on their children in the future?

Answer: Yes, committing oppression against children has a major effect on the destruction of their character and habits. When a kind of carelessness and cowardice arises in children due to the oppression of their parents, then in the future, those children have a very bad effect on the country and the nation. This is a part of their nature.
1334.left:
21 August 1920

Question: When a dispute occurs between members of someone's family, what is the solution to it?

Answer: When a disagreement arises among family members, the best way to solve it is for people of wisdom and knowledge to make a decision and try to end it. Because without family unity, the progress of a nation and society is impossible.

Question: Is it correct, and what is the ruling in Islam regarding shedding tears and expressing grief for someone after their death?

Answer: In Islam, being patient at the time of death and being content with the will of Allah Almighty is a part of faith. However, shedding tears and expressing heart-felt pain due to grief for someone is a demand of human nature, but one must not exceed Islamic limits in this.

1361.right:
Pashtun Literary Memoir
25 December 1920 AD
Pashtun Literary Memoir at the Shrine of Khushal Khan Khattak
On August 28, 1920 AD, under the auspices of the Pashtun Literary Memoir, a magnificent poetry symposium and meeting was held near the shrine of Khushal Khan Khattak in memory of Khushal Khan Khattak in the history of Islam. This event is an example for the literary world and a new step for the development of Pashtun literature. Many people had come from the villages for this poetry symposium. Almost towards the base, with the increase of literary figures and writers, people had come for the success of this symposium. Khan Bahadur Agha Lal, from the Khan Sharif hill of Peshawar, performed the duties of president in connection with this symposium. At the beginning of the symposium, Maulana Abdul Qadir Sahib was given the opportunity to serve the gathering by delivering a detailed statement on the life of Khushal Khan Khattak, his literary services, and his importance for Pashtun literature. In his view, Khushal Khan Khattak is a star of Pashtun literature, a poet who holds a unique place in the hearts of the Pashtuns.
1361.left:
In the field of Pashtun literature, this poetry symposium is a great success for the Pashtun. At the end, thanks were given to all participants for the success of the symposium, and a promise was made to build a grand memorial in honor of Khushal Khan Khattak.

In the end, a collection of Khushal Khan Khattak's poems titled "Pashtun Adab" was published by the Pashtun Literary Tazkira organization, which is a gift for the lovers of Pashtun literature.

Twenty-second

The thirty-second issue gathered on October 22, 1920, in the Pashtun Attans office building. The meeting began under the chairmanship of the Doctor. To commence the meeting's proceedings, the following points were placed before the members for discussion: Firstly, a new policy for the Pashtun Attans newspaper was discussed, and for the newspaper to progress well, very useful advice was offered by the Doctor, and a common strategy regarding this was discussed among all members. At the same time, the members also presented their views regarding the publication of the newspaper and the further strengthening of this process. In the final part of the meeting, alongside some important decisions for the future of the newspaper, some decisions were also made regarding the administrative affairs of the newspaper (the proposal to appoint Hakim Khan as the secretary of the meeting and to form a committee for the organization and progress of the meeting's work was made, which was accepted unanimously).

At the end of the meeting, a topic for a poetry symposium regarding the Pashtun Attans newspaper was also proposed so that Pashtun Attans could play its role in this area as well. The contribution of poets regarding the publication of the newspaper was also discussed, noting that in light of these efforts by the poets, the newspaper would take steps toward further achievements. At the conclusion of the meeting, the session ended with a new commitment from all members for the growth of the newspaper.

In this series, it appears that some people, in order to make their unreliable claims credible in the eyes of the people, put words and stories into people's mouths that have no connection to reason and logic. They assume that people will believe their vain and meaningless words as the truth. Such actions are, in reality, a sign of their ignorance and a disrespect to the dignity of humanity. We must protect ourselves from the words of such people and develop the ability to distinguish between truth and falsehood.

Furthermore, regarding the activities of these individuals, it must be said that they not only harm the intellectual health of society but also sow the seeds of distrust and division among the people. Society must be vigilant against such people and not allow their devilish and deceptive actions to take root in people's minds. Knowledge and honesty are the weapons that protect society against such people. To prevent such actions, great attention must be paid to the promotion of science and knowledge so that people have no doubt or ambiguity in understanding right from wrong.
1369.left: To prevent these actions, efforts must be made to raise the intellectual level of the people. Only in this way can we build a shield to defend our society against lies and deception. The light of knowledge and wisdom is necessary to eliminate these darknesses. Every individual has a responsibility to take steps in defense of the truth and not remain silent in the face of falsehood. It is the duty of every citizen to strive to speak the truth and seek the truth. Although the path of truth may be difficult, it leads to lasting success. In the end, it must be said that speaking the truth is a great virtue of humanity and plays a fundamental role in the progress of society.

A special decree has been issued by the Ministry of Education for the development of education in Kabul, the text of which is as follows:
Based on this decree, special lessons regarding public life and the benefits of knowledge must be given to students in all madrasas, and books should be prepared for them that provide detailed information about ethics and religious sciences, so that a special interest and enthusiasm for knowledge is created in the minds of the students.

1403.right:
Eid, and I will not even buy new clothes for this Eid.

Tamim Mian Sahib, Rasul Sahib, A.N.A. stood up on their feet.

On the eve of Eid al-Adha, I went to Shah Pashtun Khan's house to go to "Niamat Abad" village. He was sitting in a very beautiful room of his house, and with great enthusiasm, he wished me a happy Eid. In his conversation, he expressed great joy regarding Eid, saying: For me, Eid means the beginning of a new life. After this, there was much discussion with Shah Pashtun Khan about the historical significance of Eid and the culture and traditions of Pashtun society. He mentioned his efforts for the development of Pashto literature. In the end, with great sincerity, along with Eid prayers, he also prayed for the unity of the nation.
1403.left: In the end, many things were discussed with Shah Pashtun Khan regarding Eid, and he told me about his life experiences: that with the arrival of Eid, all the worries of my mind disappear and I prepare for a new beginning. The Eid celebration ceremonies with Shah Pashtun Khan's family and friends were very interesting. In the end, I thanked him for his hospitality, and by wishing him a happy Eid, I took my leave from "Nemat Abad" and came to my home. On this way, the moonlight of the Eid night and the silence of the environment became a cause for peace of heart. Eids are a good opportunity in a person's life for new hopes and the strengthening of brotherhood.

1404.right:
Peshawar Diary
Prior to this, the event around that time was that on February 18th, a congratulatory telegram was received from the Viceroy of India in Kabul for the Amir of Kabul on the occasion of Eid. And the Foreign Minister of Kabul also sent a congratulatory telegram in response to this telegram in the name of the Viceroy of India. In the same way, the Foreign Minister of Kabul also sent a telegram in the name of the Foreign Secretary of India, which was regarding the appointment of an Indian ambassador in Kabul. The Kabul government expressed great happiness at this action of the Indian government and thanked the Indian government for it. From the exchange of these telegrams, it appears that the relations between the governments of Kabul and India have improved significantly compared to the past, and both sides are making great efforts to improve their mutual relations. It was also said that the Kabul government has decided to send a delegation to hold talks regarding the issues of both governments. The Kabul government will give some special instructions to this delegation, upon which both countries will reach an agreement. From this news, it appears that a new era is about to begin regarding trade and other matters between Afghanistan and India.
1404.left: Regarding which individuals the Kabul government will form a delegation from, no official news has been released yet, but it is speculated that this delegation will consist of high-ranking government officials. The sending of this delegation suggests that the Kabul government wants to further strengthen its relations with the Indian government. Alongside this, news has also reached from Kabul that reforms have been initiated there based on a new model for education and other social affairs, for which a series of invitations to foreign countries has also begun. The Kabul government appears very optimistic about this series of reforms and is dreaming of a better future for its people.

Akhtar Shah realized that he had no other way to be released, so he decided to cooperate fully with the police in order to save himself from severe punishment. He began to talk about all the secret stories he had previously kept hidden, and in this way, he helped the police to arrest the other members of the group.

The police officer was very happy with this confession from Akhtar Shah and immediately ordered the arrest of the other members of the group. With Akhtar Shah's help, the police were able to raid the thieves' hideout, arrest many of their members, and also recover the stolen goods. After this incident, the people of the area were very happy because of this success of the police and praised the bravery and expertise of the police officer. Akhtar Shah, having realized that there was no way left for him to escape, confessed to his mistakes and surrendered himself to the clutches of the law.

1407.right:
On the teacher

In the first publication
Because the teacher had a series of students, something was written about the art teacher in the art school. In this, to fulfill the main purpose of this article and to understand the teacher's art and morals, a series of materials have been written. Another student has written a few sentences specifically about the teacher, which are very important materials for understanding his art and morals, and this is also an important step for understanding his art; therefore, we have included this material here in this publication.

A teacher is a king, but for what? While this teacher has a series of principles for the world of art due to having students, these principles themselves are a great reason for kingship, because a teacher rules like a king in the hearts of students due to his art. Although this rule is not by means of money, it is by means of knowledge and art.

These principles, which a teacher must himself understand, are that a student should act upon his advice and understand his words, and in the end, become a knowledgeable and artistic person like him.
1407.left:
Another student has written this about the teacher in this regard:

The teacher is a good example for kings. Thank God that there is no thought of kingship among our students. But it seems that this king is not a teacher of performance, and it is not an easy distinction. If a person rules because of a special art, there is no doubt that he will be a good teacher; rather, he will be a teacher who plays the role of a guide for every student. Like kingship, in art and other branches of life, a teacher is a great teacher for his student because of his skill in his art, and it is a proven fact that in the world of art, a teacher is a great king for his art, and there is no doubt that he is a good example for every student of his art.

The teacher himself knows that a student should act upon the teacher's advice in life. Another point worth mentioning is that in art, a teacher is not only a person who teaches art to a student, but he is also a person who acts as a good example for his student in terms of morals, and there is no doubt that an art teacher is a person for his student who guides him in all matters of his life and directs his efforts for the progress of his life, and in the end, because of his art, becomes the cause of his student's honor in the whole world.

"Education and Government"
One of the important principles of the subject is that the government
should not be known by its legitimate interference. The purpose of the establishment of government
is to gather and organize the efforts of individuals
and to assist individuals in achieving their common goals.
Professor Smith, in his book "Nation School",
writes that:
The purpose of the government's actions is that the country's inhabitants'
moral powers should be increased. It is not the government's job
to suspend the powers of individuals and lower their morale.
Rather, it is the duty of the government to create suitable
opportunities for the personal efforts of individuals and groups.

However, history is witness that the government has never
kept these duties in mind. Rather, every government always tries

1451.right:
A statement on the just and the unjust

"Mezzani" was born around the year 1804 in a village in the "Geneva" province in the land of the Afghans; his father was a poor physician and his mother was an intelligent midwife. For him, in the village, "Mezzani" was very weak, and from childhood, he had a love for the poor. When he became a young man, like others, he developed a love for serving the common people and took an interest in studying literature in university departments. It is a large part of this story that when he grew up, his family members saw him begin to speak out for the rights of the poor in the village; in the beginning, he spoke to the village elders on behalf of the poor. According to him, the poor are also entitled to the rights of this homeland, and work must be done to provide them with the facilities of life. However, this kind of help for the poor appeared very bad to the Khans and leaders of that time; they made many efforts to prevent this work of his, but Mezzani was firm in his resolve. Once, to help a beggar, he gave him bread and clothes from his own money; when people saw this, they were very surprised by this act of his. This was a stage in his life that showed people that the poor and the rich are equal before God; because of the effect of this, a new consciousness and knowledge began to emerge in his village.
1451.left: From the time of his birth in this new village, throughout his life, he was in search of a cure for the pains of the poor in every one of his actions. Because of his words and the actions he began for the service of the nation after this point in his life, the people of his homeland looked at him with love and respect. Whatever it was, a great sign of service to his homeland and its people was visible in every one of his actions and words.

At that time, the talk in people's hearts regarding the Pashtuns of India was that the Mughal Emperor Akbar was trying to be hostile toward the Pashtuns and eliminate them. When the Pashtuns stood against Akbar Shah's government, the Pashtuns of India faced very great difficulties. Akbar Shah moved toward India with his army to crush the Pashtuns and subjected them to severe hardships. During the time when Akbar Shah was waging wars against the Pashtuns of India, the Pashtuns also stood against their enemy with great determination to defend their homeland. At that time, Akbar Shah had made major plans with his army to eliminate the Pashtuns. When the Pashtuns faced Akbar Shah's army, they put up very strong resistance against it. In that war, the Pashtuns suffered great losses and were unable to continue opposing Akbar Shah's army. At this time, due to discord and lack of unity among the Pashtuns of India, Akbar Shah succeeded over them and paved the way for the destruction of Pashtun rule in India. At this time, under a major plan to capture Pashtun territories, Akbar Shah sent his army to the Pashtun regions and caused the Pashtuns great suffering in their own lands. During this time, the Pashtun leaders became engaged in wars with Akbar Shah's army to protect their homeland, and by capturing the Pashtun regions, Akbar Shah further strengthened the foundations of his rule on Indian soil.
1457.left: During this time, the Pashtuns were subjected to many acts of oppression and tyranny by Akbar Shah's army, and since the Pashtuns were not united during that era, Akbar Shah took advantage of this opportunity to further increase his control over them; the difficulties that the Pashtuns faced during this period have been recorded as a historical fact, and the circumstances of that time had a significant impact on many aspects of Pashtun life, leaving deep effects on the foundations of their political and economic life.

1459.right:
Pashtun Heroes -- 49 -- 21 September 1920
My heart trembles with the pride of Afghan identity, because in the fold of this pride lies the expression of that existence and the symbol of the honor and dignity of that nation, which has left such echoes of glory in the world that even today every honorable Afghan takes pride in them. There is no room for doubt that in the field of honor and courage, that wave of the bravery of Ahmad Shah Baba's army, which was dancing towards India as a powerful army of the Islamic world, and left this mark in the fear of its enemies' hearts, that this is a courageous nation that confronts all kinds of invaders at the cost of their lives. But if we turn the pages of history in search of such past waves, our eyes rest upon a hero like Ubaidullah Khan and the self-sacrifice and devotion of Ahmad Shah Baba's army, who did not care for their lives or wealth in this path of honor. Throughout his life, he created such epics for the freedom of the homeland that will be written in golden letters on the pages of history forever. The stories of this hero's courage and bravery still teach every young person a lesson in defending the country today. He left behind such examples in his actions that they served as an unbreakable force against all forms of colonialism and tyranny. (Maulana Najibullah)
1459.left:
Pashtun Hero
As previously mentioned, this story of Ubaidullah Khan's courage and bravery is not only a lesson for the country's freedom, but an important chapter of that struggle which was launched for the pride of the Pashtun nation. Considering the circumstances of that day, it becomes clear that the courage of Ubaidullah Khan and the sacrifices of his companions actually raised a great storm of fear in the heart of the British colonialism of that time. From these pages of history, it is also evident that it was impossible for any kind of power to stand against the honor and bravery of the Pashtuns. The struggle of these heroes was not just for the protection of a land, but for the protection of that pride and dignity which has been inherited by the Pashtun nation from history for centuries.

Dear and respected ones! You are aware of the state of our homeland due to the British colonial system. They have seized our wealth, and our people are living in poverty and misery. Regarding the true civilization and education, it is a great necessity for the Pashtun and for the well-being of the Pashtun himself that steps be taken to establish a system at the national level so that a broad and standard education system can be created for the people of the country. This is a path in which every citizen of the country can obtain their right. For the importance of this education, it is necessary that efforts be made to create a curriculum at the national level that will enhance the mental abilities of the people. Its goal should be the promotion of science and knowledge for the progress of the homeland, not just for a specific class. The current system that exists pays attention to the interests of a specific class, due to which most of the people of our society are left without education. We must try to ensure that education is in accordance with the needs of the people and that every citizen can benefit from the blessing of education in their own country. No matter how many obstacles there are in this path, we must move forward for a bright future and work for the progress of our country in the light of knowledge. Our goal should not just be to build schools, but to create an environment in which everyone has equal opportunity for learning. With this, every individual in our society will participate in the progress of the country and a strong society will be created.
1471.left:
A short note regarding the great need for the development of true civilization and education:

In reality, national education is a necessary step for the common interests of all and for the well-being of society. Unfortunately, the current system in the field of education has a series of shortcomings, due to which the people of the country remain deprived of their true right. In these circumstances, a major change is needed in the field of education that opens the doors of knowledge for every citizen of the country. Current education is for a limited circle, while education as a social right should reach everyone. For the development of education, it is necessary that policies be formulated at the government level that take into account the needs of the people and that practical steps be taken for the progress of the country. In this way, the people of our society will not only be equipped with the light of knowledge, but will also shine in the world as a strong and developed society. It is the duty of every Pashtun to strive for the popularization of education and to raise their voice for this important task.

A look at Albania

Albania's (late) King "Ahmet Zogu" is one of those figures of the world who rose above the ordinary status of his merit and courage.

This king, the story of the death of Jalal Beg, among the tribes of Albania, besides the status of his own trade, was the brother-in-law and deputy of Sultan Abdul Hamid. He was born in 1895. Ahmet Zogu was raised in Albania in a way that prepared him for the path of leadership. Until 1915, Albania was part of the Turkish government. But when a freedom movement started against the Sultan's wrong government in Turkey, the idea of the freedom of his own homeland began in Ahmet Zogu's heart. At the age of twenty, he joined the movement. He endured exile, imprisonment, and the hardships of war. Finally, he succeeded in his goal. In 1925, he became the Prime Minister of Albania and in 1925, he became the head of Albania. Finally, in 1928, due to his ability and power, he was made King of Albania and took the title "Zogu".

During the time of the freedom movement, he faced many enemies. The people of Albania, like the Wazirs, believed in blood feuds. Controlling these bloodthirsty people was not an easy task. Ahmet Zogu was a brave man. He was successful in controlling them. He was targeted by enemies. There were reports of him being targeted for assassination three hundred (300) times. He was attacked many times. But fate saved him, and he remained alive.

He kept his palace under the protection of machine guns and often did not participate in public meetings.

Ahmet Zogu was a very learned man. He could speak German, French, Turkish, and Serbian. He was fond of studying history and spent his nights busy with work for the betterment of the country.

Zogu was very skilled in maintaining law and order among the people. He brought them under control through his behavior with his prisoners. Whenever he found out that someone intended to rebel, he would call them to the palace and bring them under control through his behavior.

A priest, Fan Noli, was his very staunch enemy. When Zogu came to power, he exiled him. He was living in America. Finally, he became very ill, and the money for his treatment ---

A message of condolence from Pashtun on the grief of the passing of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan
Alas and a hundred times alas that a great leader like Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan, a fighter for the freedom of the homeland who always raised his voice against the oppression and tyranny of the British, and who understood the pain and sorrow of the nation's heart, is no longer among us today. His passing is a great tragedy for the entire nation. In this grief, not only his family and friends but all those who dreamed of the independence and prosperity of the homeland are in mourning. The history of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan's life and struggle is a shining example for those who are prepared to sacrifice their lives for the path of truth and reality. 1682.right:
Tipu Sultan's Memory

30
August 1939 AD

In such a situation, when dark clouds of slavery were spread over many parts of India, in such a corner of the land of India, which is known as Mysore, a shining star emerged that lit the lamp of hope for freedom in the hearts of Indians. This shining star was "Tipu Sultan", who dedicated his entire life to the path of freedom.

Tipu Sultan was not only a shrewd politician but also a brave military leader. He understood that for the freedom of India, a systematic and united voice was needed against the British. He established contacts with leaders from different parts of India and urged them to stand against colonialism.

An important part of his life was his confrontation with the British. He defeated the British armies in many battles and prevented their expansionist policies. His bravery and perseverance were a source of inspiration for the people of that time.

But unfortunately, due to some traitors and allies of foreigners, Tipu Sultan joined the ranks of martyrs in an important battle. His death was a great loss in India's struggle for freedom, but his message and love for freedom remained forever in the hearts of Indians.

In conclusion, we can say that Tipu Sultan's struggle is an excellent example of an untiring effort for justice. He believed that freedom is the right of every human being and that any sacrifice for this right is permissible. Although he is not among us today, his achievements and his love for the homeland are forever written in our history.

It is essential for us to learn this lesson from Tipu Sultan's life: to always have the spirit of sacrifice for the freedom and dignity of our homeland. If we want to leave a dignified and free India for our future generations, then we must follow in the footsteps of leaders who sacrificed their lives for truth and justice.

This lamp of freedom that Tipu Sultan lit, today we all must collectively preserve. It is our national duty to keep the memory of such heroes fresh and to work for the progress of our country according to their guidance. Tipu Sultan's soul will be happy when we stand on our own feet for the freedom and survival of our homeland.

The situation in foreign countries
The confrontation between Germany and France. News from London has become known that German troops are gathering in three large border regions of Germany. The German army has moved towards the southern side of Moselle and Saarbrücken. The confrontation between the French and German armies has begun, and both sides are fighting. One report says that on the Siegfried Line, the center is not very visible, and the French are fighting with great bravery. A military expert has estimated the power of both governments in such a way that there are 500,000 soldiers on the German line, and France has 500,000 soldiers ready for war. It has become known from a French announcement that Germany will attack the French with great force, because France has occupied a large area since the beginning, and they will certainly try to take it back. If they attack Saarbrücken, they might suffer a loss of 100,000 troops, but it is clear that the French have made great preparations. 1755.right:
Pashtun Editorial
This monthly magazine named "Pashtun," published in 1929, discusses on this page the importance of unity, brotherhood, and mutual assistance among Pashtuns. At the beginning of the text, a call for Pashtun unity is made, followed by a detailed explanation of its benefits and the harms of discord. The text begins as follows:
The benefit of the nation is the benefit of every Pashtun; therefore, it is necessary for all to unite. For the progress of this nation, the path of consensus should be taken instead of prejudice. If we unite among ourselves, no one will dare to look at us with ill intent. This article also emphasizes the importance of knowledge and education, and calls upon the youth to strive for education in order to serve their nation. The article concludes with a slogan for the unity of the Pashtun nation.
1755.left: In my opinion, if we want to become a strong nation, we must adapt ourselves to the demands of the times while preserving our traditions. In particular, women's education and the training of the youth are what shape our future. In every section of this issue of Pashtun, various stories and advice regarding unity have been written. This magazine presents a vivid picture of the social situation of that time and is a step towards efforts for unity among the Pashtuns. It is hoped that the contents of this magazine will bring about a positive change in the minds of the readers.

Situations in Foreign Countries
War Preparations in Iran and Iraq The Egyptian newspaper writes that war preparations are underway in Iran. There are reports of a large army gathering in Qazvin, Khorasan, and Isfahan. There are reports of army concentration in the western parts of Iraq, towards the desert of Western Iraq, along the border of Iran. Service to God's Creation

A Notice
Regarding the publication of the second year of Pashtun
Awakened Pashtun in 1928

Serving God's creation is a virtue that has been mentioned extensively in the holy religion of Islam. The Prophet (PBUH) has said: "God's creation is God's family, so the most beloved of God's creation to God is the one who does good to His family," meaning God's creation is God's family, so the one most beloved to God is the one who shows kindness to His family (creation). In the light of the holy religion of Islam, when we look towards serving the people of Pashtunkhwa and humanity in general, it becomes incumbent upon us to gird our loins for this service. The Pashtun magazine, which was established for this very purpose, intends to present such content to its readers that will lead to the elevation of their knowledge and national consciousness. We hope that our writing contributors will assist us in this path, so that we may become capable of serving our nation.

Now, they asked us to provide security that we would give the money within that period.

The Nawab summoned his officers and told them to inform the soldiers to be patient, as he would pay their full salaries after four months. But instead of four months, two years passed. The outstanding balance of the army's salary was not paid, which caused the Nawab to owe two more years of salary. Lytton is a very important and influential name in the series of international affairs of that time, who held a special position in the politics of British India. He had a unique perspective regarding the issue of the northwestern frontier regions of India. In Lytton's view, the solution to the Afghanistan issue was vital for the survival of British India. 2790.right:
Freedom
Freedom of nations:-
It is clear that it is the desire of a group that it should be its own master and leader—in the same way, it is also the aspiration of a nation or community that it should take advantage of its freedom and rule over itself. If, out of compulsion, someone else's government is imposed upon it, then it considers that extreme humiliation and disgrace.
Here, if the question is asked whether, if all nations were in agreement, could they become one?
The answer to this is that this issue is based on a major foundation—that if two nations are in agreement regarding religion, language, customs and traditions, and interests and losses, then their becoming two nations is not actually harmful. But if they are not behind one another, but rather in conflict and competition—
And if, in the aforementioned statement, both nations are affected in certain things, then saying they are not one nation is a severe detriment. In this case, for the subjugated nation, "freedom" is a matter of life. Such as England and India.
And if this question is asked, what is the benefit of "independence" after subjugation?
The believer says that there is another great benefit. Just as new things can be raised from the work of the great, the king's authorities and the obstacles of laws can be removed, and [others] can be forbidden from interference. And to everyone who is given authority, in the beginning, this intoxication also leads to mistakes. But for this, the suitability of freedom is required, and [if so] then they will pay more attention to their own self-correction and will reform themselves, and for the correction of their own soul, they will strive even more.

2803.right: It is good that these few words came at the beginning of my speech, and this is also so that my dear readers may understand that in these sittings of mine, there are many other tasks that must be completed before this. However, these sittings are intended for my dear brothers to understand what has passed through my heart during this time that has gone by. There have been many times when I have not known whether to do this or not, but in order for my brothers to be informed of these circumstances, I do this. In the course of some of the events of my past time, which I will narrate to you one by one, there was a condition on that day that contained much within itself. And because in these circumstances, which I had taken upon myself for the good of this nation, I saw many difficulties in carrying out these tasks, and my heart was very fearful upon seeing the fate of these works, wondering how this task would be brought to an end and what state my nation would be in. However, there were many other such matters in this that, for the sake of my nation understanding this situation, I was compelled to write this whole story briefly, so that my other brothers might also be informed of how my heart felt during that time regarding the conditions of my nation, how exhausted I became in these tasks, and that for the service of this nation, I have carried out other works as well, relying on God Almighty, which have resulted in the benefit of the nation.
2803.left:
In conclusion, it must be said that the purpose of my writing is not to show off, but rather that my brothers become informed about the actual circumstances of this time, and that this is history, which must be preserved for future generations. If this work had not been done at that time, these events might have faded from people's memories and the space for the truths of that era would have remained empty in the pages of history. Thus, in this writing of mine, an attempt has been made to mention every difficulty and joy on the path of serving the nation in the light of the truths of the time. It is hoped that this writing will gain the attention of my dear readers and become a cause for stirring sentiments of service to the nation and the country in their minds. These sittings are not just a statement of my heart's condition, but a mirror of a time that reflects a sensitive period in the life of the Afghan nation. Finally, I pray in the court of God Almighty that He spreads peace, stability, and the light of knowledge and wisdom in our country, and enables our young generation to work bravely for the progress of their country and nation. Because the progress of a nation depends on the determination and action of every individual. With respect.

(June)

The fact that these regions have such a great place in the history of Muslims, from the past travel of their own Muslims to India and the beginning of the spread of religion in these regions through the preaching of the faith, has prepared the people of this region to sacrifice themselves. Likewise, with the arrival of the British, these Muslim regions have stood as a resistance through the slogan of unity and brotherhood, in the path of the demand for freedom.

While the arrival of colonialism in these Muslim regions led to the efforts of these people through the sacrifice of their lives and property, they continued their efforts to preserve their religious and national values as a slogan for the demand for independence by the Muslims of India. In the same way, among the Muslims, the development of this spirit of demand for freedom and the struggle of the people of this region against the cruelty and tyranny of the British, through their own consensus, has led them to employ all their efforts to make any kind of sacrifice.
2810.left:
Then, their contribution to the struggle for freedom and the spirit of sacrifice in that path, for the Muslims of this region in India, is commendable. The people of this region have always tried to stand against the oppression and tyranny of the British by preserving their religious and moral values. In the same way, the freedom-seeking spirit of the Muslims of this region has remained an example and a model for the Muslims of India. This struggle of the Muslims of this region stands as a great sign of the unity and consensus of the Muslims of India and as resistance against British colonialism.

Furthermore, in the path of this struggle of the Muslims in these regions, they have carried out their efforts in strengthening the spirit of unity and consensus of the Muslims as a result of the sacrifices made. Therefore, for the Muslims of India, the sacrifices of the Muslims of this region in the path of continuing the quest for freedom and the struggle against British colonialism are worthy of being remembered forever. And this struggle will remain recorded forever in the pages of history as the path for the freedom-seeking of the Muslims of India.

2819.right:
Third - The blessings of independence
God (J) has Himself stated in the Quran, "And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him," meaning if anyone relies on God, He is enough for him; this matter must be kept in the balance of the heart. This is not just a matter of the tongue, but requires proving in practice. If one truly relies on God, there is no force on the face of the earth that can stand as an obstacle to the will of a nation.
By the blessing of independence, our holy homeland was saved from the pit of discord and took steps toward unity. Throughout their history, the children of this country have always been seekers of freedom, but foreign interference had harmed our national unity. Today, as we are the masters of our own destiny, it is a blessing of the blood of those heroic martyrs and the strength of those warriors who have recorded deeds of bravery in the pages of history.
We must realize that freedom is a great blessing from God (J), and showing gratitude for this blessing lies in its protection and in strengthening national unity. If we become united among ourselves, then preventing foreign conspiracies will be easily possible. Educating the future generation in the light of knowledge and wisdom is a shared responsibility of us all. Steps must be taken for the advancement of education and training so that our youth have the ability to combat the challenges of the era.
The contribution of every individual is important for the prosperity of this homeland. Whether a farmer, a laborer, a scholar, or a writer, each one is an important pillar in the series of building this country. Relying on our country's products and freeing ourselves from foreign imports is the first step toward economic independence. Therefore, it is necessary that we support our domestic industries and make efforts to stand on our own feet.
2819.left:
Love for the homeland is a part of faith; therefore, every Afghan should not shy away from any sacrifice for the development of their country. History is witness that Afghans have never bowed their heads before oppression and tyranny, and this is the great pride of our people.
The conclusion is that independence is not only political freedom, but it is the path to a nation's dignity, honor, and progress. We must accelerate our movement toward the prosperity of our country by preserving this freedom. In the shadow of unity, we can take our place among the other developed nations of the world and lead our country to the highest heights of honor and pride.
May God (SWT) keep our beloved country forever prosperous and safe from all kinds of misfortunes. Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

2820.right:
Kabul, 1349 Shamsi year
Compromise: In the event of a thief or murderer being caught red-handed, the implementation of strict measures by the government regarding saboteurs, in light of the government's decision that authorizes the taking of any kind of measures in the path of strengthening national security, is worthy of the full support of the people. However, despite this, it is worth noting that the implementation of these actions within the framework of the law is what causes the prevention of social chaos.
Question: What is the opinion of the Minister of Justice of Afghanistan regarding these recent decisions?
Answer: The Minister of Justice, in line with the declaration published by the government, has stated that the protection of the people's rights is the primary duty of the state and no weakness will be tolerated in this regard. The welcome of these steps by the government from the people is a sign of their intelligence.
Section: The reaction of the people regarding the formation of a special committee by the government is considered an important step for strengthening the country's security. The duty of this committee is to investigate those who are involved in various criminal incidents. The rule of law is essential for the progress of any society and no tolerance should be shown in this regard.
Note: For further clarification of this matter, discussions have been held with the government spokesperson, which will be published in the next issue.
2820.left:
In this regard, the Minister of Justice said during his remarks: "The foundation of our law lies in ensuring the security of the people. Anyone who commits actions against the law must be handed over to the clutches of the law. The government is obligated to protect the lives, property, and honor of the people."
This decision has been met with a warm welcome by the people throughout the country. According to a group of Kabul residents: "We fully support this step by the government and hope that this process will be implemented rapidly across the whole country."
In conclusion, it is worth mentioning that the increase in coordination between the government's security agencies has led to these successes. The Ministry of Interior has stated in this regard that they are working day and night to strengthen the security of the society.
However, it is worth noting that security measures alone are not enough to solve the problems of society; rather, the government's efforts in the fields of education, economy, and job opportunities are also commendable.
This report was prepared by a reporter for the Kabul newspaper.

Over the past few years, such rumors have spread everywhere in our country that have rooted fear and anxiety in the hearts of common people. Although these rumors had been on people's tongues for a long time, they have recently taken a form that has preoccupied everyone's thoughts. People say that the conditions of our country are changing, and every day new events occur that have deep impacts on the country's economic and social life.

Along with this, in some areas, the living conditions of the people are becoming harder day by day, which has become a cause of people's dissatisfaction. This is not just a matter of economic problems, but people also have complaints regarding the lack of justice and fairness. In such circumstances, it is the government's responsibility to pay attention to these problems of the people and take practical steps to solve them, because public trust is an important pillar for the survival of any government. If the government takes serious steps in this direction, it is believed that the people's concerns will be removed and the country will take steps toward progress and prosperity.

Furthermore, promoting knowledge and education and providing suitable conditions for the education of youth are vital for the future of any country. 2827.right:
Introduction
For Zardozi
Just as this series has been started in our magazine for the advancement of the art of Zardozi, this section also considers the historical background of this art, the rights of workers, and the issue of promoting this art as an important matter, which is considered a major step toward artistic and literary development at our national level.
In this regard, there is a felt need for research and precise, comprehensive studies on artistic and literary affairs, so that the views and experiences of scholars, artists, and experts in this field can be utilized as a vital resource, ensuring that the art of Zardozi—a historical and valuable art—receives special attention as a lasting heritage for the new generation.
Furthermore, it is necessary to mention the efforts made by certain individuals and institutions during past eras to promote and develop this art, which saved it from decline; their contribution in this regard is significant.
Ultimately, this magazine is a step that serves as an important and valuable resource for increasing the knowledge of art and culture enthusiasts and historians, and it will be used as a guide for future parts of this series to expand their information.
2827.left:
About the art of Zardozi
In the light of justice
For the sake of territorial level development and the strengthening of justice, it is necessary to consider a legal framework in this art sector to protect workers and their rights, so that alongside the growth and development of this art, the lives of the workers remain protected from all kinds of problems.
As a part of England's history, the growth of this art is closely related to their industrial revolution, during which these artistic activities became the focus of special attention and were used as an important tool for the development of this art.
The art of Zardozi is essentially known as an artistic skill that is a sign of human elegance, precision, and patience, and recognizing the value of the work of every kind of artistic hand in this field is an important issue.
In conclusion, for the preservation of this art, there is a visible need for the unity of all relevant organizations, and especially the artists, and the coordination of their efforts, so that they can fulfill their historical responsibility in protecting this national heritage in the best way.

Sultan Saladin Ayyubi prayed for his soldiers for the help of Almighty Allah and the victory of Islam. Sultan Saladin Ayyubi, along with his army, prepared for the battle against the strong walls of the Christian soldiers for the conquest of Jerusalem. When they became distressed by the atrocities of the Christians, they sought help from the Caliph of Islam and voiced their cry to him, but they (the Caliphs) were in a state where they themselves were embroiled in various problems and were not prepared to help the Muslims.
These atrocities of the Christians continued until other Muslims of the Islamic world thought about this matter and started working to help the Muslims of Palestine. This situation of the Palestinians is very painful, that in their own homes they see signs of oppression from the Christians, all kinds of life facilities are blocked for them, and there is no security for their lives and property.
While the life of the Muslims of Palestine has become very difficult due to the oppression of the Christians, they are requesting help from the Islamic world, and it is necessary for them (the Islamic world) to take serious steps in this regard, so that this bad situation of the Muslims of Palestine ends and they are given the opportunity for a life of honor and security."

First page - 42
In this article, it is also stated that this series of atrocities by Christians against Muslims is still ongoing, and in the absence of Muslim unity, these atrocities are increasing day by day. For the Muslims of Palestine, the unity of the Islamic world and raising a voice to help them is very essential.
The author adds that efforts at an international level are needed to defend the rights of the Palestinian people, so that Christians may desist from these evil acts of theirs and give Muslims the opportunity to obtain their rights.
This article has been published at a time when Muslims in other parts of the world are also concerned about the situation in Palestine and are emphasizing the importance of the unity of the Islamic world for their salvation.
In conclusion, the author requests all Muslims to help the oppressed Muslims of Palestine and to make every effort to defend their rights, because it is the religious and moral duty of every Muslim to support their oppressed brothers.
In the same way, this story of the Muslims of Palestine is an important reminder for all Muslims regarding the lesson to be learned and the necessity of unity, and it shows that until Muslims become united, they will not be safe from the atrocities of their enemies.

If their purpose for education is merely worldly gain and obtaining government positions, then instead of benefit, this education will be harmful to their people and their nation, because in the absence of a specific principle of religion and faith, education is like a power that, if used in the wrong way, becomes a cause of destruction for society. Therefore, we tell the new generation that education is necessary, but along with education, the spirit of serving one’s religion and national consciousness is also essential.

Petals on the path of life

On the path of life, we face many hardships and sufferings, but behind every difficulty, a ray of relief is hidden. This is the true path of life: that we stand on our own feet. These efforts of the people of Pashtunkhwa for independence and the preservation of their culture are worthy of praise. Every young person must get to work for the progress of their homeland. No matter how many obstacles there are on the path of love and affection, we must not give up. In this journey of life, we are all one and are working for a common goal. True stories depict the lives of those people who seek a path to success in the midst of adversity. It is necessary for us to benefit from the speeches of our elders and lay a strong foundation for our future. Let us maintain a bond of love and affection with every petal of our homeland. It is the youth who lead the change in society and recognize their responsibility in awakening their nation.

2832.right:
Magazine "Afghan", dated March 9, 1920

Announcement for the owners of freedom

Imagine that history is moving through a very strange and fascinating stage of humanity. In this era, such a great transformation has occurred that all colonialism and tyranny on the face of the earth is trembling. The uprisings of the people of India, the national movements of the people of Turkey, and the passion in the hearts of Afghans themselves to quench the thirst for independence—amidst all these major events, Afghans appear more determined than ever to decide their own fate. Here the question arises, how can these rays of hope for the freedom of nations reach their goal?

The answer lies in the unity of the nation and the full understanding and honesty of its leaders. Nations that have fallen victim to neglect in the face of the conspiracies and deceit of their enemies along the complex paths of their history are heading toward decline. But a zealous nation like the Afghans, which has never bowed its head to any tyrant in its history, must defend its rights in the light of knowledge. Against the enemies of our nation, the greatest weapon is the path of learning and strengthening unity. In every region of the country, the fire of love for independence must be kept burning in the minds of the new generation, so that future generations may be more powerful than before in protecting the country.
2832.left:
And in its light, continue towards independence.

Letters of the homeland after the announcement of Fayaz
In the discourse of the time towards innovation in life, we must admit that after winning freedom, preserving it is very difficult. The changes in world conditions are proceeding rapidly. In these circumstances, we must raise our country's economy, culture, and level of education. Today, we fight not only with the power of the gun, but also with the power of knowledge and art. It is the duty of every Afghan to take their part in the path of building the homeland. Whether it be the pen, the shovel, or the shedding of sweat in the field of work.

We must have unity among ourselves and not be deceived by the deceit and hypocrisy of outsiders. In the path of defending the homeland, we must not withhold any kind of sacrifice. History will judge the men of our time as to whether we were truthful in our path or not.

In conclusion, this is a note for all patriots that the prosperity of the country depends on the courage of every individual.

(Editorial by Toofan Sahib)

Respected Farm Doctor: Mr. Meherban, questions regarding the major crops of our province—such as rice, maize, millet, tea, and others—are rarely raised, and attention is not given to them. Instead, all their attention is focused on rice crops.

Since the expenses on loans for the sake of, for the sake of industrial development are significantly higher, it is obvious that there is a flaw in the government's policy. The expenses on the police and government systems are increasing, and they have no proportion to the improvement of the province. Justice demands that out of agriculture and industry, from which 2.5 million in revenue is obtained, only 500,000 rupees are spent on them; more funds could be spent. For this reason, the claim that there are no funds for industry is completely baseless.

For the Pashtun nation, the way to escape this catastrophe is through such a strong national uprising and unity that, by the grace of God Almighty, will be the way to liberation from the chains of this despotic system. If we gather our self-sacrificing and brave Pashtuns together, then breaking the chains of this slavery will be very easy. For the Pashtun nation, there is a need for an organized and purposeful struggle to achieve its rights and independence, in which the participation of every Pashtun is essential, and one must be prepared for every kind of sacrifice on the path of this struggle, because the future honor and independence of the Pashtun nation is hidden in the success of this struggle.
2859.left: In conclusion, for the Pashtun nation, there is a need for such national leadership for this kind of unity and struggle that understands the pain of the Pashtun nation and takes steps to solve their problems. These Pashtuns of ours, who live in mountains and deserts, are in need of such leadership that leads them towards a bright future. Therefore, this national uprising is an important step not only for the liberation of the Pashtun nation but for all oppressed nations. If we lose this opportunity, then there will be no way left for the awakening and unity of the Pashtun nation. So let us all become united and gather under a single national agenda to defend our land and our honor, which is the first step towards our prosperity and success.

Issue number 13

Year 1329

Announcement of the Kabul Mushaira!

Announcement of the Kabul Mushaira! This Mushaira (poetry symposium) is being organized with the support of the Ministry of Education's Department of Information and Culture so that literary scholars and poets may gather in Kabul. The purpose of this Mushaira is the development of the Pashto language and literature and the encouragement of the new generation. This Mushaira will be a major path for the elevation of the Pashto language.

Conditions for participating in the Mushaira:
1. Every poet must submit one or two of their poems, which should be in various Pashto language forms (Ghazal, Qasida, Rubai, etc.), to the Mushaira committee.
2. The subject of the poems must be in accordance with the demands of the time and the needs of society.
3. Participants must submit their poems to the Ministry of Education by the specified date.
4. At the end, awards will be given for the best poems by the leadership of the Mushaira.

This Mushaira is an important step for the flourishing of Pashto literature and it is expected to have significant results for the advancement of the Pashto language.

The honor and bravery of the Pashtun is recorded on every page of history, and the struggle against all forms of tyranny is the goal of a Pashtun's life. Pashtunwali!

It seems that for the sake of the honor and pride of Pashtunwali of our poor and oppressed Pashtuns, as in recent times in some provinces, due to a series of misunderstandings by some people and the ignorance of others, they were burning in the fire of their own enmities one after another and losing their lives and property in this path, something happened that hurt the heart of every pained Pashtun, and this was considered a major obstacle to the unity and cohesion of the Pashtuns for a long time, and these enmities also had a very bad effect on the culture and civilization of the Pashtuns in a very bad way, and because of this, such senseless wars and problems were always created by some ignorant people, which could be considered a major obstacle in the path of the country's progress and prosperity.

Looking at this, a number of the country's intellectuals and well-wishing leaders of the Pashtun nation decided that a step should be taken to eliminate these senseless and useless enmities, and to spread a message of peace, brotherhood, and unity among the people of this society, and in this path, they proposed the creation of a joint Pashtun Jirga and discussions in this Jirga to solve these problems, which in itself is considered a very important and historical step in the path of Pashtun unity.

Recently, during the Jirga formed for the purpose of Pashtun unity and ending enmities, Pashtun leaders began efforts to resolve their differences with great sincerity, and their efforts were a matter of joy and hope for all those who sought benefits in the unity of the Pashtun nation, and during this Jirga, with the participation of a number of Pashtun tribal leaders, youth, and scholars, it was decided to prevent further enmities and, alongside this, to hold discussions within the framework of knowledge and logic regarding all the problems that exist among the Pashtuns.
2898.left:
which opens a new chapter of unity and brotherhood for the Pashtuns, and alongside efforts for the success of this Jirga, all Pashtuns were requested to choose the path of Jirga and dialogue to resolve their differences, to work together for the prosperity of their nation and country, and this Jirga is remembered as the beginning of a new page in Pashtun history that carries the good tidings of peace and brotherhood.

It was emphasized by all participants of the Jirga that everyone must strive for the unity and solidarity of Pashtuns, create an atmosphere of love and brotherhood instead of hostility and hatred, and be ready to make any sacrifice in this path; it is the duty of all Pashtuns to stand in one rank for the honor and pride of their nation, to resist the conspiracies of outsiders, and in this path, the weapon of knowledge and wisdom is considered the most important weapon.

In the end, members of the Jirga requested all Pashtuns to take steps towards knowledge and education for the development of their regions, to pay full attention to the education and upbringing of their children as it is the best investment for their future, and the Jirga pledged to create special plans for the spread of education and knowledge for the future of the Pashtun nation.

The fact that the Ministry of Education, in order to encourage all kinds of innovations and scientific efforts in the path of serving the homeland, has started a scientific and literary publication named "Watan" in the series of education publications for the development of the Pashto language, is a step that is welcomed by Afghanistan's intellectuals in the field of education and literature, and there is no doubt that it will play a major role in enlightening the minds of the country's children.

Writing is a matter that has an unparalleled role in shedding scientific light on the human mind. If we look at our past historical assets, a large part of our scientific wealth has remained preserved in these written forms; therefore, now that the Ministry of Education has taken this initiative, it is incumbent upon every Afghan to struggle for the prosperity of the country in this path through the language of their pen.

Since science is the foundation of the development of every society, the "Watan" publication will be able to lay a good foundation for the dissemination of education at the national level, and for our young generation, it will be a source that will quench their thirst for learning science and literature. Anyone who wants to take a step in this path should pave the way for the future of the country by means of their pen.
2904.left:
Carrying out all kinds of scientific and literary efforts for the purpose of serving the country is our common duty, and in this path, the role of "Watan" publication is commendable. I hope that this publication becomes an effective tool for promoting knowledge among Afghans and plays a positive role in raising the scientific level of the country.

In the end, it must be said that such publications for strengthening the pen are extremely necessary for enlightening society, and in the series of educational publications, we hope for its increase so that it keeps the torch of knowledge lit in every region of our country.

2905.right:
Pashtun

13 March 1920

(Issue One)

"Pashtun"

I intend to form such an association of Pashtuns that will strive for their knowledge and the betterment of their lives, and become a strong voice for the preservation of Pashtun history and culture. I know that there are many difficulties for this task, but my heart is full for the progress of my nation and I will not hesitate to make any kind of sacrifice in this path. In this magazine, we will present articles, news, and analyses for the education of our Pashtun brothers, the improvement of their economic situation, and the provision of social justice. I request all Pashtuns to support this nationalist movement, so that we can save our homeland from all kinds of colonialism and backwardness. May God be our helper in this pure goal and may He make us successful in our efforts for the unity and glory of the Pashtun nation.
2905.left:
Personal notes:

Recently, some friends have expressed the wish that a structured path be paved for the youth of our nation so they can organize their lives in a scientific and practical manner. A major reason for the laziness and negligence of our youth is the lack of a structured guide. In this magazine, we strive to fill those gaps and find ways for the awakening of the Pashtun nation that will lead to the prosperity of our nation in the future.

It is worth mentioning that these efforts of ours are solely for the unity and independence of the Pashtuns, and we do not in any way want to use this magazine against anyone. We want to strengthen love, brotherhood, and the sense of living as a single nation among our brothers. We hope that every Pashtun realizes their responsibility in this path and participates in our material and spiritual support.

Receive it regularly, this is the Pashtun magazine.

The "Pashtun" administration

From Sheikh al-Hind Maulana Mahmud al-Hasan
An admonitory lesson for the unity and accord of Muslims
This is a time when Muslims are divided by internal discord and misery; because of this discord, the fabric of their honor and dignity has been torn to pieces and they have fallen into pits of humiliation. The Almighty God has commanded them to unite and agree, but they have trampled this command of God underfoot. The disagreement that exists among them is the cause of their destruction and ruin. It is necessary for Muslims to unite, gather as one, recognize their enemies, and protect themselves from them. If they wish to succeed in this world and the hereafter, they must live their lives in the light of the holy religion of Islam and strive for each other's welfare. God Almighty is with them if they unite, and in the face of their enemies, success will be their fate.
(By Maulana Sheikh al-Hind)

2908.right:
Editorial

The Pashtun

12 April 1920 AD

The desire of my heart and Pashtunkhwa

My heart desires to meet with the people of Pashtunkhwa in a place where there is an opportunity to express the desires of my heart. I earnestly request the people of Pashtunkhwa to work together in unity to preserve their language, their culture, their history, and their honor. Today, there are many among us who sow the seeds of discord among our people for their own selfish interests and destroy our unity. I call upon our leaders, our youth, our writers, and our intellectuals to come, let us adopt the path of unity and take steps on the path of knowledge and enlightenment to serve our nation. It is necessary for us to raise the cry of unity and brotherhood in our schools, in our gatherings, and in our newspapers. If we become united, no power can resist us. This is the voice of my heart; this is my message of love for every Pashtun who burns with love for their land and their nation. I pray to God Almighty to bless our unity and give us the ability to serve our nation.

2909.right:
Peshawar: -
Ever since the experts of Peshawar city learned that the government intends to implement a water pipeline system in the city streets, waves of happiness have emerged in the hearts of the people, because the city residents have been facing severe difficulties for a long time due to the shortage of clean drinking water. With the start of this project, not only will the people's health improve, but there will also be a great improvement in the cleanliness of the city. This step by the government is being welcomed by the general public, and the residents of this region are praying from the bottom of their hearts for the success of this government action. They are hopeful that this project will be completed in a very short time, and people will benefit from this major facility.

On the other hand, according to some sources, the survey of various areas of the city for this project has been completed, and the work of laying water pipelines will begin practically very soon. It is said that the government has allocated a special budget for this project so that there will be no obstacles in the distribution of the water pipeline network in all parts of the city. The city residents consider such steps taken by the government to be in the interest of the people and express hope that other facilities will also be provided to them in the future. It is worth noting that due to the lack of a water pipeline system in Peshawar, people had long relied on well water, and water contamination was also a major problem in some areas. However, it is now expected that with the completion of this new project, these problems will be completely solved, and clean drinking water will reach the people easily. This was a long-standing desire of the people of the region which is now on the verge of being fulfilled, and the people seem very happy with this step of the government. In this regard, the elders and youth of the region have expressed their happiness and demanded the immediate implementation of this project.

2910.right:
Kabul Magazine, a Pashto publication

In the court of the servant of the servant, the beloved friend, Allah (SWT)

In the early days of Kabul magazine's publication, the question in the readers' minds was what this magazine would be for, and what is its purpose?

It was made clear in the first issue of Kabul magazine that the goal of this magazine is to work for science, knowledge, and the progress of society. This magazine will help in raising the level of people's knowledge. Our aim is to spread the light of knowledge in this country and for our compatriots to become familiar with new sciences and knowledge. Useful content regarding history, literature, politics, and social issues will be published in this magazine. We hope that our compatriots will expand their knowledge by reading this magazine and contribute to the progress of society.

Furthermore, writings by the country's renowned writers and scholars are also published in the magazine, from which readers will benefit greatly. We strive to make each issue more interesting and useful than the previous one. We hope that all compatriots will help us in strengthening this magazine and send us their valuable writings and opinions. The series of magazine publications will continue in the same way, and we will make tireless efforts in this path to serve the people of our country.

Note: Along with the above content, information regarding the Ministry of Education's new educational plans has also been provided in this issue. The goal of these plans is to improve the quality of the country's schools and to provide a foundation for better education for the new generation. Besides this, several articles regarding the improvement of the country's economic situation have also been published.
2910.left:
With the help of God, this series will continue, and we will use our pen for the benefit of the country and the people.

This magazine is a new step for the development and strengthening of the Pashto language. We thank all those who have cooperated with us in the printing and publication of this magazine.

- By the administration of Kabul Magazine
